'dzin 'gyur/ /de yi phyir na brdar btags pa/ /mi srid do zhes kha cig smra—/ ༈ /de dag gi ni brdar 'dogs la/ /shing min rnam par gcod dam minaske/ /gal te rnam gcod shing gi don/ /'dzin pa med na ji ltar shes/ /brda las de dag mi sel na/ /tha snyad 'dogs par byed pa rnams/ /de yongs spangs nas 'jug par ni/ /mi 'gyur shing gi khyad par bzhin/ ༈ /gal te gzhan bkag mi sgrub par/ /mdun gnas gcig gcig rab bstan nas//'di shing yin zhes brda byed la/ /tha snyad 'dogs pa'i tshe na yang / /de rtogs 'gyur la de yi phyir/ /nyes pa 'di ni med snyam na/ /'di yang shing yin 'di kho na/ /zhes bya'i thal ba ldog pa med/ ༈ /gcig rtogs zhes bya'i shes pa ni/ /gcig la gnas pa'i rtogs pa pos/ /de dang de min rgyu don rnams//bdag nyid rnam par 'byed par byed/ ༈ /blo de la ni yod pa'i dngos/ /blo rgyu nyid du snang ba dang / /rgyu min ngo bo bral ba dang / /ngo bo gcig 'drar bdag nyid kyis/ /tha dad par ni shes 'gyur bas/ /tha dad pa la skad sbyor te//de las de rtogs 'gyur ba'i blo/ /'khrul pas dngos po gcig ltar rtogs/ ༈ /blo don 'ga' las rnam bzlog nas/ /don 'ga' zhig la 'jug bya'i phyir/ /sgra ni rab tu sbyor byed de/ /de don nges par gzung phyir ro/ /gzhan du sbyor ba don med 'gyur/ ༈ /des na shes bya la sogs tshig ༈ /tha snyad du ni 'jog rnams la/ /rnam par gcod pa 'ga' zhig yod/ ༈ /gang zhig gang las tha dad pa/ /de rnam ①bzlog nas de dag las/ /tha dad khyad par mtshungs pa'i rgyurka/ /rnam pa sdesnang ba can la 'god/ /de nyid gzhan las ldog pa yis/ /dngos po de yi cha 'ga' zhig /rtogs 'gyur zhes pas rab tu bshad/ /'di 97—480

la'ang ngo bo cung zad med/ /sgra rnams las de rtogs nyid kyis/ /gzhan bzlog rtogs 'gyur de la ni/ /'ga' yis khyad par du byas pa/ /rtogs par 'gyur ba gzhan 'ga' med/ ༈ /sgra gnyis byed pa'ang ma yin te/ /phan tshun yod pa min phyir 'di/ /dngos med dngos po ldan nyid du/ /mjong ba blo yis bslad pa yin/ /de nyid phyir 'di don dam min/ ༈ /gzhan du dngos po las ldog pa/ /dngos por mi 'gyur 'di 'di las/ /tha dad ces ①ni brjod phyir ro/ ༈ /'dres pa'i don gcig gcod pa na/ /sgra 'am rtags ni gcig pu ④yis—/ /bya byed de la bcad pa yisne/ /dngos po'i brjod bya ci yang med/ /gang gis rjod dupar byed pa las/ /ma lus par ni rtogs 'gyur ba/ /dngos po'i nus pa yin nges na/ /'bras bu du ma rten gcig 'gyur/ ༈ /rnam gcod gcig gcig ston pa na/ /gang tshe gzhan mi spong bar gnas/ /des ni de ⑤khyab gcig pu'ang snang / /de tshe blo yi ngor byas nas/ /gzhi mthun pa ni nyid du 'gyur/ ༈ /sgra ni rnam gcod byed pa na/ /dngos po'i chos la reg 'gyur ba//de ni de la yod ces bya'o/ ༈ /dngos po gcig ni rjod rjobyed min/ /blo la snang min snang rung la/ /dngos po med pas nges phyir ro/ ༈ /de phyir gzhan sel yul can gyi/ /sgra rnams dang ni blo nyid kyang / /spyi yi yul can du bstan te/ /dngos la de dag mi srid phyir/ ༈ /dngos po'i ngo bo gcig nyid phyir/ /ngo bo tha dad blo gang las/ /gcig ni rjes su 'gro ldog gi/ /don gcig spyod yul can ma yin/ ༈ /tha dad gyur ⑦na dbyer med pa'i/ /tha snyad dag kyang rgyu med 'gyur—/ ༈ /ldog pa kun la yod pa'i phyir/ /thal 'gyur nyes pa de dag med//de yi 'bras bu yongs bstan phyir/ /tha dad 'bras bu gcig dag la/ /rgan 97—481

pos sgra gcig brdar byas pa/ /de yi 'bras bu med pa can/ /ldog pa yi ni rgyu can yin/ ༈ /tha dad pa dag bstan pa ni/ /dka' dang mi nus 'bras med phyir / /dngos po la min dngos po kun/ /rang rang ngo bo la gnas phyir/ /khra bo yi ni ngo bo gang / /de ni ser skya la yod min/ ༈ /de 'bras yin ①min las bzlog ④pa/ /gnyis ka la yang yod pa yin/ ༈ /don la tha dad med par ①yang / /sgra yi tha dad mi rigs so/ ༈ /de phyir de 'bras 'dod na yang / /de 'bras med las tha dad nyid/ ༈ /dper na mig la sogs pas rjogazugs/ /rnam shes gcig gi ⑤'bras bu can/ /gang phyir khyad par med 'bras de/ /ston pa dag ni srid par 'gyur/ ༈ /'ga' zhig cig car kun rtogs phyir/ /de yi ngo bo spyi las ni/ /tha dad med du zin na yang / /brda las byung ba bsnyad rjopar bya/ /gal te gcig gnas pa yi phyir/ /mang po dag la'ang mnyan pa gcig /gnas pa rten dze+enam gsal ba yin/ /de ltar de la mi rigs so—/ /rtags ⑦la phan 'dogs med pa'i phyir/ /rten min rtsang ba'i tshul can gyi/ /rgya shug sogs la'ang de yi yul/ /skyed ⑨pa 'khar gzhong sogs pas nus/ /de yang de la mi srid do/ /de med na yang gnas pa'i phyir//gnas min de yang mi rigs te/ ༈ /tha dad tha dad min pa yi/ /rnam par dpyod ⑩pas mi rigs nyid/ /bdag la rnam shes skyed ⑪rung ba'i/ /don du gzhan gyi ngor byed gang / /gsal bya yin la rung nyid kyi/ /byed pa po yang rgyu ru 'dod/ /'di ni snga nas rung nyid na/ /de la ltos pa mi rung ste/ /'gyur ba med pa'i phyir de ni/ /spyi ldan pa las gang las yin/ /mig sman sogs bzhin gsal ba las/ /dbang po'ang 'du byed ma yin te/ /de ni yod med 97—482

dus dag la/ /rtogs pa tha dad med phyir ro/ ༈ /rigs rnams kyi ni gsal byed kyang / /gal te rigs dang ldan 'dod na/ /sgon me ①la sogs gsal byed ni/ /ba lang nyid sogs de ldan 'thob②/ ༈ /gang dag rigs ni gsal ①ba las/ /gzhan nam gzhan min yod nyid de'i/ /sngon med gsal dub rnams la ni/ /spyi yi blo gros ji ltar yin/ /gcig la yod pa mthong ba ⑤ni/ /gzhan la mthong ba mi srid phyir/ ༈ /gzhan nyid min na rjes 'gro med/ /gzhan nyid na yang rten min phyir/ ༈ /mi 'gro de na yod pa'ang min④/ /phyis yod cha dang ldan pa'ang min/ /rten snga ma ni yongs ⑦mi 'dor/ /kye ma phongs pa'i rgyu nyid yin/ ༈ /gzhan la gnas par gyur pa ni/ /rang gi gnas las mi g.yo zhing / /de las gnas gzhan skye ba la/ /gnas na shin tu rigs par ldanaske/ /gang na dngos de gnas gyur pa/ /der ni 'brel pa'ang ma yin la/ /de dag yul can la khyab pa/ /ci ga de ni ngo mtshar che/ ༈ /gal te kun na rigs yod na/ /gcig tu gsal ⑧bas de gsal ⑨nyid/ /tha dad med phyir kun du mthong / ༈ /de yang gsal ⑩ba la ltos min/ /gsal byed rtogs pa ma yin na/ /gsal bya yang dag rtogs pa min/ /spyi dang de dang ldan pa dag /ci yi phyir na bzlog par 'dod/ ༈ /tha dad med don med par yang / /'tshed pa po sogs brjod pa yin/ ༈ /tha dad phyir na las rgyu min/ ༈ /'di yi rigs min las 'byel phyir/ ༈ /mnyan pa gzhan gyi rgyu mtshan phyir/ ༈ /las kyang gnas pa yod ma yin/ ༈ /'byel pa med phyir sgra yi rgyu/ /spyi ⑪yin mi rigs min pa min/ /ha cang thal phyir las med na'ang / /shes rjod ⑩dag gi ma yin te/ /rgyu mtshan can min thob phyir ro/ ༈ /rjes 'gro med phyir nus 97—483

pa'ang min/ /gal te 'tshed ①po nyid sogs spyisde/ /dang po nyid du de yod sogs—/ /bzhin du gsal 'gyur min na ni/ /khyad par med phyir phyis mi 'gyur—/ ༈ /bya bas phan 'dogs ltos gsal byed/ /yin na 'gyur med ltos pa med/ /'di ni phul byung yod na yang / /skad cig nyid phyir bya gang lasarka/ ༈ /tha dad mtshungs pa yin na rigs/ /nye ba gang gis 'ga' zhig la//rab 'jug gzhan la min de nyid/ /sgra dang shes pa'i rgyu yin no/ ༈ /gal te ldog pa spangs pa yi/ /dngos po'i rjes 'gro gzhan rnged na/ /gcig gi ①'bras bu gzhan gyir minarjo/ /shin tu tha dad phyir zhe na/ ༈ /gal te bdag nyid gcig pa yis/ /du ma 'bras bu gcig byed na/ /bdag nyid gcig la'ang de yod phyir/ /lhan cig byed pa don med 'gyur/ /tha dad med pa'i ngo bo de/ /mi 'gro khyad par rnam nges bral/ ༈ /gcig dang bral na 'bras med phyir/ ༈ /bye brag rnams las de dag 'byung / /don byed nus pa gang yin pa/ /de nyid don dam yod pa yin/ /de yang rjes 'gro med gang zhig /rjes 'gro de las 'bras mi 'byung / ༈ /de ⑤na bdag nyid tha dad kyang / /'ga' zhig rgyu yin gzhan pa min/ /rang bzhin 'di yin tha dad pa/ /med na cig car skye 'jig 'gyur/ ༈ /de las tha dad pas de ltar/ /mi 'gyur zhe na gcig 'jig tshe/ /bdag gnas na ni de yi min/ /des na spyi khyad blor mi 'gyur—/ /ldog pa ngo bo nyid med phyir/ /gnas dang mi gnas rtog rjopa min/ /spyi yi blo yang bslad pa yin/ /de phyir sun dbyung ba yang med/ ༈ /de yi skyed byed ngo bo gang / /de las gzhan pas ji ltar skyed⑦/ ༈ /tha dad khyad par nyid skyed byed/ ༈ /de la ⑧tha dad min pa'ang yod/ /ce na des de skyed ⑨min 97—484

brjod—/ ༈ /snang ba'ang gzhan la mi brten pas/ /tha dad byed yin de nyid don—/ /de ni gzhan las log pa yin/ /de ni rgyu dang 'bras bur bshad/ /de ni rang gi mtshan nyid 'dod/ /de ni blang dor 'bras can pas/ /skyes bu thams cad 'jug pa yin/ ༈ /ji ltar tha dad med khyad med/ /na ①yang thams cad kun sgrub min/ /de bzhin tha dad khyad med na'ang / /thams cad kun gyi sgrub byed min/ ༈ /tha dad na yang dngos po yi/ /chos nyid kyis 'ga' byed por 'gyur/ ༈ /tha dad med na'ang gcig nyid kyi/ /byed dang mi byed 'gal bar 'gyur/ /tha dad yod de'i phyir bya med/ /ce na lhan cig byed mi byed/ /'on te rim bzhin byed po nyid/ /de ci dngos de nyid kyi 'am/ ༈ /de ldan dngos po shin tu ni/ /tha dad tha dad med 'gyur ba'am/ /'dra dang mi 'dra'i bdag nyid can/ /rnam grangs phan tshun tha dad 'gyur/ ༈ /de yang tha dad 'gyur zhe na/ /bdag nyid gang gis de dag gi④/ /khyad par spyi zhes bya ba de/ /gal te de dag dze+etha dad na/ /tha dad nyid 'gyur de lta na'ang //ji ltar bum sogs phan tshun bzhin/ /spyi dang khyad par du 'dod pa'ang / /spyi dang khyad par can mi 'gyur/ /gang gi bdag nyid mdun byas nas/ /bsgrub bya de 'bras 'dod pa can/ /skyes bu 'di ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de rten tha dad tha dad med/ /dpyad bya rang bdag nyid tha dad/ /ldog pa mtshungs pa 'di ④dag ni/ /yod nyid dngos po ⑤rjes 'gro med/ /'jug pa la sogs thal 'gyur phyir/ ༈ /de nyid kyis ni 'dzem med pa/ /mun sprul gang ci'ang rung smra ba/ /de dag kyang ni bsal ba yin/ /mtha' gcig pa ni srid phyir ro/ /thams cad gnyis ka'i ngo bo nyid/ /de yi khyad par bsal ba'i phyir//97—485

zho 'thung zhes ni bskul ba na/ /ci phyir rnga mo la mi rgyug /'on te phul byung 'ga' zhig yod/ /gang gis khyad par 'jug 'gyur na/ /de nyid zho yin de gzhan la/ /med phyir gnyis ka min gzhan min/ /thams cad kun bdag nyid yin na/ ༈ /blo sgra tha dad par mi 'gyur/ /tha dad bsdus par ①smra ba la/ /de med phyir na mi srid 'gyur/ ༈ /dngos med ngo bo med pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo brjod pa dpyad bya nyid/ /ma yin sgra ni de dag nyid②/ /rnam gcod rjod par byed par ①grub/ /rang bzhin khyad par bye brag la/ /ltos pa'am 'on te 'ba' zhig pa/ /bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i phyir brjod de/ /'jig la 'bras dang yod nyid bzhin/ /gal te gtan tshigs yod rang bzhin/ /yod pa ji ltar bsgrub bya min/ /khyad par rjes 'gro med pa ni/ /gtan tshigs bsgrub bya dag las nyams/ /yod pa'i khyad par tsam du ni/ /bsgrub bya spyi yi chos can la/ /don 'ga' zhig yang dhi'agrub mi 'gyur/ /'di 'dra ba yang bkag pa med/ ༈ /khyad par bsgrub byar bzung na 'dir/ /gtan tshigs rjes 'gro med can 'gyur//yod pa bsgrub bya yin na des/ /khyad par dag ni bsgrub byar 'gyur/ ༈ /de yi khyad par gzung med par/ /dngos po tsam na rjosgrub pa na/ /de tsam khyab byed bsgrub bya yi/ /rjes su 'gro ba nyams pa med/ /ma grub pa la yod chos medarka/ /gnyis ka la brten 'khrul pa can/ /med pa'i chos ni 'gal yin na//yod de ji ltar bsgrub byar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin sgrub dupa go byed yin/ /de la khyab byed nges pa yin⑦/ /rang bzhin nges pa go bya yin/ /'di ldog pa na de ldog byed/ /dper na mi rtag nyid byas pa'am/ /ma byas pas na ⑧mi 'jig bzhin—/ ༈ /rgyu med phyir na 'jig pa na⑨/ /rang gi ngo bos rjes 'byel nyid/ /97—486

dngos po ltos dang bcas rnams ni/ /nges par 'gyur ba med par mthong / /de ①rgyu mang po yod na yang / /'ga' zhig la ni mi srid 'gyur/ ༈ /des na 'bras gnas med pa'i phyir/ /'jig pa rgyu ldan smra rnams kyi/ /'jig pa'i rgyu ni thams cad dag /'khrul pa nyid du bshad pa yin/ ༈ /de rgyu nus pa med phyir yang / /'di ni ngo bo nyid kyis 'gyur/ /gang la 'gyur zhes bya de las/ /gzhan la'ang ngo bo nyid kyis 'gyur/ /des na dngos po'i yul can gyi/ /rjes su dpog gang rnam gnyis te/ /'bras dang ngo bo de dag lasasde/ /rang bsgrub bya la 'byel des phyir/ /'jug pa blo sngon can nyid phyir/ /de yi ngo bo mi dmigs na/ /'jug par mi byed ces bya bas/ /mi dmigs pa ni tshad mar bshad—/ /bstan bcos skabs dang 'byel med dang / /don rnams dbang po las 'das pa/ /rtags med pa can de rnams ni/ /mi dmigs phyir na ji ltar med/ /yod med nges pa'i 'bras can min/ /phyir na tshad ma nyid mi 'gyur—/ /rtags kyi phul byung yod pa can/ /la la tshad ma dag tu 'gyur①/ /rang bzhin shes byed mi shes la/ /rigs pa 'di ni brjod pa yin/ ༈ /rgyu mi shes na 'bras bu ni/ /med pa nyid du sgrub par byed/ /don rmi rang bzhin rtags can la/ /rang bzhin mi dmigs pa yang yin/ /gal te gtan tshigs 'ga' zhig gis/ /de med par ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /snang rung mthong ba med pa'i rgyu/ /mi srid par ni gyur pa na/ /snang rung dngos po ma rjodamigs pa'i—/ /dngos po med pa rtogs par 'gyur/ ༈ /'gal ba'i dngos po yod na yang / /de yod pa la gnod byed phyir/ /de dang 'gal ba dmigs pa ni/ /med pa nyid du nges par 'gyur/ ༈ /thog med bag chags las byung ba'i/ /97—487

rnam par rtog pas yongs bsgrubs pa/ /yod med gnyis ka la brten pa/ /sgra don chos ni rnam pa gsum/ ༈ /de dngos nyer len med pa can/ /sgrub la de mi dmigs pa ni/ /de ltar gtan tshigs de nyid ni/ /med pa ma yin sgra sbyor phyiraske/ ༈ /don dam gcig tu 'jug nyid can/ /mthong ba'i bye brag tha dad pa'i—/ /don rnams la ni sgra rnams ni/ /rgyu med can 'jug mi 'gyur dang / /'das dang ma skyes pa la yang / /tshig 'ga' zhig kyang brdzun pa yi/ /don can nyid du mi 'gyur phyir/ /de dag blo don yul can 'dod/ ༈ /sgra don bsnyon pa sgrub pa la/ /chos kyi rten ni bsal ba'i phyir/ /tshogs pa bsgrub byar mi 'gyur la/ /yan gar chos ni grub pa yin/ /sgra don bsnyon pa med rnams kyis/ /yod med phyogs kyi bye brag gis/ /dngos po nyid ni dpyad bya ①ste / /'di las 'bras 'byung rag las phyir/ ༈ /don byed nus pa ma yin la//don gnyer brtags pas ci zhig bya/ /ma ning gzugs bzang mi bzang zhes/ /'dod ldan rnams kyis brtags ci phan/ ༈ /rtog ②pa'i shes pa'i yul nyid kyis//sgra yi don ni brtags pa yin/ ༈ /dngos rten ma grub 'di chos su/ /rig pa smra bas gsungs pa yin/ ༈ /sgra rnams dngos dang lhan cig tu/ /med na mi 'byung ①nyid med phyir/ /de las don grub min de dag /smra po'i bsam pa ston par byed/ ༈ /yid ches tshig ni mi slu ba'i/ /spyi las rjes su dpag pa nyid—/ /'brel pa dang ni rjes mthun thabs/ /skyes bu'i don ni rjod byed ngag /yongs brtags dbang du byas yin gyidu/ /de las gzhan pa'i dbang byas min/ /mthong dang ma mthong dngos po yi/ /don de dag la mngon sum dang / /rjes su dpag rnam gnyis kyis kyang / /gnod med 'di yi ⑤mi 97—488

slu ba'o/ ༈ /yid ches tshig ni mi slu ba'i/ /spyi las 'di yul lkog ①gyur na'ang / /go skabs med pa'i phyir blo ni/ /rjes su dpag pa nyid du gsungs/ ༈ /blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni/ /thabs bcas rab tu nges pa yis/ /gtso bo'i don la mi slu'i phyir/ /gzhan la rjes su dpag pa yin/ ༈ /skyes bu phul byung la ltos pa/ /ji bzhin don du gzhan gyis shes/ ༈ /gal te phul du byung ba de//shes par nus na don 'di 'dod/ ༈ /'di ni 'di lta'am min no zhes/ /gzhan la skyon ldan skyon med pa'am/ /tshad ma rnams ni rnyed dka'i phyir/ /rtogs dka' zhes ni gzhan gyis shes/ /'grib dang phul byung brten pa kun/ /mi mthun phyogs dang bcas nyid phyir/ /de goms pa las bdag 'gyur bas/ /la la zag pa zad par 'gyur/ ༈ /'tshe ba med dang yang dag don/ /ngo bo nyid la phyin log gis/ /'bad du zin kyang mi bzlog ste④/ /blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /nyes pa rnam pa thams cad dag /'jig tshogs lta las skyes pa yin/ /de ma rig der de la chags/ /de las zhe sdang la sogs 'byung / /de nyid kyis na nyes rnams kyi/ /rgyu ni gti mug yin par gsungs/ /gzhan las 'jig tshogs lta ba ste/ /de spangs pa na sgong phyir ro// ༈ //tshig rnams log pa nyid kyi rgyu/ /nyes rnams skyes bu la brten phyir/ /skyes bus ma byas bden don can/ /zhes ni la la rjod par byed/ /tshig rnams bden pa nyid kyi rgyu/ /yon tan skyes bu la brten phyir/ /skyes bus ma byas log pa'i don/ /cis min zhes ni gzhan dag brjod/ ༈ /don shes byed pa dag gi rgyu/ /brda ni skyes bu la brten pas/ /tshig rnams skyes bus 1byas min yang / /de phyir log pa nyid du srid/ ༈ /'byel pa skyes bus byas min na//97—489

brda rig med par rtogs par 'gyur/ /brda las de ni gsal yin na/ /brtags sdepa gzhan dag nus med 'gyur/ ༈ /tshig rnams don gcig la nges na//don gzhan rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ ༈ /don du ma dang mngon 'byel na/ /'gal ba gsal bar byed pa yin/ /skyes bus ma byas pa nyid kyang / /kun du brtags ①pa don med 'gyur/ /tha dad rnams la 'brel ①pa yang / /rnam par gzhag phyir gtan tshigs brjod/ ༈ /skyes bus legs par ma byas pa④/ /rnam pa kun du don med 'gyur/ /legs byas khas len na 'di ni/ /dngos su glang chen khrus 'drar 'gyur/ ༈ /'byel pa can rnams mi rtag phyir/ /'byel pa la rtag yod ma yin/ ༈ /de phyir don dang sgra yi de/ /skyes bu'i blo yis legs par byas/ ༈ /don dang lhan cig skyes na ⑤ni/ /sgra rnams la ni rang bzhin dag /rnam par bzlog par mi rigs so/ ༈ /rnam brtags 'byel la nyes 'di med/ /gal te rten 'di rjo'ajig na yang / /'jig min rtag phyir rigs dang 'dra/ /rtag rnams la brten nus pa gang / /gang gis de rten ⑦'dod pa yin/ /shes pa skyed par byed pa yis①/ /lhan cig byed rgyu rnams ⑨tshogs na/ /de skyed ⑩par ni rung nyid phyir/ /rig pa shes pas bum sogs kyang / /skye ba la ni gsal ⑪bar 'dod/ /'gyur ba med rnams khyad med pas//gsal byed rang gis ⑫don ci byas/ /gang phyir des de gsal 'dod pa/ /'byel pa dngos po nyid gyur mod/ /tha dad phyir blo sna tshogs 'gyur/ ༈ /de las tha dad min de nyid/ /'di las gzhan dngos yod ma yin/ /dngos po'i ⑫ngo bo tha dad phyir/ /'brel pa rtog pas byas pa yin/ /yod rdzas gzhan la rag lus pa'am/ /gzhan gyi 'brel par ji ltar 'gyur/ /yi ge don med can 97—490

'gyur zhing / /tshig sogs kun brtags dngos med la/ /dngos po yi ni 'byel pa 'di/ /ji lta bur ni 'jug par 'gyur/ ༈ /byed pa po rnams mi dran phyir/ /skyes bus ma byas kyang 'dod lo/ /'di la'ang rjes su brjod pa yod—/ /des na ngan pa'i mun pas khyab/ /ji ltar skyes bu 'di gzhan las/ /ma thos par ni yi ge dang / /tshig bkod pa ni brjod nus med/ /de ltar gzhan la'ang 'ga' zhig smra/ ༈ /spel ba yi ni gzhung gzhan yang / /man ngag las gzhan gzhan dag gis/ /'don pa gang mthong gang gis na/ /de yang de ltar rjes mi dpog ༈ /rigs gang gang las grub pa de①/ /khyad par med de me shing bzhin/ /rgyu ma mthong ba can gzhan yang / /de las 'gyur bar yang dag shes/ /de la 'bras mtshungs mthong ba'i phyir/ /khyad par dag ni ma bstan par/ /gtan tshigs rab tu spros pa gang / /de dag thams cad 'khrul pa can/ /rnam kun thog med grub gyur mod/ /de ltar skyes min rten can min//de phyir skyes bus ma byas nyid/ /gzhan yang mi la mi brten 'gyur/ ༈ /kla klo la sogs tha snyad dang / /med par smra ba'i tshig rnams kyang / /thog med phyir na de bzhin 'gyur/ /sngon 'dus ⑦byas pa'i rgyu yin phyir/ /de 'dra'i skyes bus ma byas nyid/ /grub na'ang ①yon tan ci zhig yod/ /don gyi 'du byed khyad par rnams/ /mthong phyir the tshom dag kyang yin/ ༈ /yig rnams gzhan dang khyad med phyir/ /sgrub par byed na 'bras cir 'gyur/ /ngag ni yi ge las tha dad/ /yod pa min te ma dmigs phyir/ /yan lag du ma'i bdag nyid yin/ /de rnams tha dad don med nyid/ /de dngos can min de dngos can—/ /brtags pa seng ge nyid sogs bzhin/ /re re don bcas nyid yin 97—491

nam①—/ /du ma nyid btags ①log pa yin/ /yan lag gcig ni rtogs pas kyang / /ngag gi don dag rtogs par 'gyur/ ༈ /thams cad cig car rtogs ①pa na'ang / /dus kyi khyad par mi rung ngo / ༈ /gcig nyid na yang tha dad med//rim gyis rtogs pa mi srid phyir/ ༈ /mi rtag na ni rtsol byung phyir/ /de ci ④skyes bus byas pa min/ /rtag nyid yin yang ⑤rtag par ni/ /dmigs 'gyur sgrib g.yogs med phyir ro/ ༈ /gal te lhan cig byed 'ga' zhig /ma tshang thos pa min zhe na/ ༈ /cis kyang gzhan ltos yin sla ༷ste/ /nges pa dag ni 'gal ba yin/ /gal te de dag khyab byed min/ /thams cad du ni dmigs mi 'gyur/ ༈ /gal te khyab na thams cad kyis/ /cig car dmigs pa dag tu 'gyur—/ ༈ /'dus byas dmigs pa yin na yang / /'gyur med gang gis 'du byed 'gyur/ ༈ /dbang po legs par byas gyur na/ /des kyang ma lus thos par 'gyur/ /gal te legs byas khyad par las/ / tha dad phyir don gcig nges yin/ ༈ /sgra yi tshogs pa du ma yi/ /ca co ji ltar thos par 'gyur/ ༈ /de la gal te sgra yan gar/ /thos 'gyur rjod byed ma yin na/ ༈ /sgra las tha dad yod do zhes/ /'di la shin tu ches dad bya/ ༈ /sgra gzhan dag ni gnas pa na/ /rjod byed ji ltar thos pa yin⑦/ ༈ /yang na nus pa nges pa'i phyir—/ /ji ltar tha dad sgra rtogs 'gyur/ ༈ /nyes pa gang dang gang gis kyang //sgra tsam rjod byed mi 'dod pa⑧/ /sgra tsam dag gis gsal ba nisti/ /ji ltar rjod byed la de med/ ༈ /gal te yi ge rim pa dag /yig rnams tha dad med phyir min/ /de dag rnam par gzhag pa'ang med/ /go rims gzhan ni 'gal phyir ro/ ༈ /khyab dang rtag par brjod pa'i phyir/ /yul dang dus kyi go 97—492

rims med/ ༈ /mi rtag khyab byed ma yin pa'i/ /skyon yang sngar ni brjod pa yin| ༈ /gsal ba'i rim pa'ang ngag min te/ /rtag la gsal ba gsal ①phyir ro/ ༈ /byed pa rnams kyi bya sdenyid las/ /de grub phyir na 'bras nyid yin| ༈ /grub pa'i don la rab ①shes pas/ /gzhan blo'i rgyu ni gsal byed 'dod—/ /dper na sgon bzhin gzhan du na'ang / /byed po las 'di khyad par ci/ /byed pa rnams kyi tshogs pa yi/ /bya ba las ni nges par yang /dmigs phyir 'bras bu nyid yin te/ /gsal byed la de mi srid phyir/ /gal te khyed kyi de ngo bo'i/ /sgrib byed bral ba gsal duyin na/ /ci phyir med pa la byed pa'i/ /tshogs kyi nus pa de rung 'gyur/ /sgra dang khyad par med pa'i phyir//gzhan dag kyang gsal thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin du ni khas len na/ /rgyu rnams kun ni don med nyid/ ༈ /ngo shes pa dang yong sbyor sogs/ /gang yin sgrub byed 'dod na ni/ /dpe med can yin dngos rnams ni/ /skad cig gis ni 'jig phyir ro/ /rtags ngan gzhan yang sun dbyung bya/ /blo ni skyes bu'i rten can min/ /khas blangs mngon sum grags pa dang / /rjes su dpag pas cig car gnod/ ༈ /yi ge rnams las tha dad pa'i/ /rim pa'ang gsal bar dpyad zin to/ ༈ /de ni rtog pas sgo btags na/ /ji ltar skyes bu'i rten can min/ ༈ /'jig pa yod tsam 'brel pa can/ /nyid phyir sgra ni mi rtag nyid / ༈ /me las don gzhan gyur pa dag ༈ /skye na 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ /shing ni mthong ba nyid du 'gyur/ ༈ /de nyid 'di yis ⑤'jig ce na/ /ji ltar gzhan ni gzhan 'jig 'gyur/ /bla ste ci phyir shing mi snang / /des gzung phyir min zhe na min/ /gang phyir de yis mi sgrib ste/ /skye phyir 'jig pa 'jig 97—493

can 'gyur/ /de lta ①na yang shing mthong 'gyur/ /gal te gsod byed bsad pa na/ /nag pa slar 'byung min ji bzhin/ /'di la'ang de bzhin yin zhe na/ /gsod byed bsad sdepa nyid ma yin/ ༈ /'jig pa gzhan nyid ma yin na/ /shing nyid 'jig pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de med phyir na rgyu min nyid/ /'di las gzhan pa'i rnam pa'ang med/ /'jig pa rgyu med can yin na'ang / /rtag phyir dngos po 'jig pa dag /lhan cig yod par 'gyur zhe na/ /med pa rtag nyid gang ①las yin/ /med la dngos 'jig med nyid kyi/ /thal bar 'gyur ba mi rung ste/ /gang phyir dngos po 'jig pa yis/ /'jig pa dag ni mi 'dod do/ /dngos 'jig gzhan la ltos med phyir/ /de shes don du sems kyis ni/ /de yi tha dad sgro btags nas/ /gnas skabs de rgyu med can bshad/ ༈ /med pa durang nyid las yod na'ang / /rnam rtog 'di ni mtshungs ⑤she na/ /de yi cung zad 'gyur med de/ /med par gyur pa tsam zhig yin/ ༈ /yod la rnam rtog 'di rjo'agyur te/ /bsgrub ⑦pa dngos dang 'brel ④phyir ro/ ༈ /med pa yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ /dngos po min zhes bya ba'ang yin/ /gal te bya ba cung zad cig /yod na gzhan la ltos 'gyur gyi/ /dngos gang cung zad mi byed la//ci ste 'ga' zhig gis ltos 'gyur/ ༈ /des ni rgyu med can yin na'ang / /ma skyes pa las 'jig 'gyur phyir/ /yod pa nyid dang ⑨'jig yin skyon/ /ha cang thal ba bsal ba yin/ /ji ltar skye ⑩ldan 'ga' zhig nyid/ /thogs bcas nyid 'dod de bzhin du/ /yod rnams 'jig pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /skye ldan min pa min ce na/ ༈ /rgyu yi rang bzhin nges pa las/ /'bras bu'i rang bzhin nges pa ste/ ༈ /tha dad rgyu rnams med nyid phyir/ /mi rtag ngo bo tha 97—494

dad med/ ༈ /de phyir de rnams 'brel pa yang / /rtag pa nyid ni bsal ba yin| ༈ /sgra yi nus pa'ang sngar bshad pa'i/ /'brel pa'i skyon gyis bsal ba yin/ ༈ /skyes bus ma byas zhes bya nyid/ /ji bzhin don shes sgrub byed min//skyes bu'i nyes pas skyon med pa'i/ /me sogs rnam pa gzhan du mthong / ༈ /de ni ma byas par 'dod na/ /shes pa nyid kyi rgyur mi 'gyur/ /rtag pa dag la ①dngos nus pa/ /'ga' yang skye ba yod ma yin/ ༈ /rnam rtog bag chags las byung ba'i/ /sgro btags spyod yul can blo dag /'ga' zhig de las skye sde'agyur gyi/ /don gyi spyod yul can ma yin/ ༈ /gal te byas dag log nyid du/ /mthong nyid phyir na ma byas pa'i/ /tshig ni bden don can yin te/ /bzlog pas 'gal ba khyab phyir ro/ ༈ /med phyir gtan tshigs ma bstan na'ang / /de ni yod par dogs 'gyur snete/ /dngos po 'gal ba dag la yang / /khyab par byed pa mthong phyir ro/ ༈ /kun la med pa mi dmigs pas/ /mi 'grub ces ni bshad zin to/ /med pa nyid ni ma grub na/ /ldog pa nyid la the tshom za/ /gal te rjes 'gro ldog pa dang / /bsgrub bya'i chos can la yod nyid/ /de des 'bras can shes pa yis/ /grub par gyur na sgrub byed yin/ ༈ /gang la bsgrub bya'i mi mthun phyogs/ /bzlog pa nyid brjod de nyid ni/ /'di yi chos mthun 'gyur ④des na/ /gtan tshigs thams cad rjes 'gro can/ ༈ /'ga' yis brda byas nyid yin na/ /sngags rnams 'bras bu sgrub byed yin/ ༈ /ci ste dngos po'i nus yin na/ ༈ /khyad par med phyir gzhan la'ang ⑤'gyur/ /don gzhan nyid du gyur pa yi/ /bkod pa'ang sngar ni bsal ba yin/ ༈ /de don rtag tu 'grub du'agyur te/ /ltos pa yin na nus med 'gyur/ /gal te dngos 97—495

nus de 'dra na/ /de ni kun gyi sgrub byed 'gyur①/ ༈ /legs byas min phyir byed pa po'i/ /khyad par la yang ltos mi rung / /dngos po 'dus byas pa yi yang / /dngos po'i tha dad tha dad byed/ /byed po'i khyad par las nus pa/ /nges pa ma yin brda las 'gyur/ /khyad par byar med can yin na/ /ci zhig byed nas byed por 'gyur/ ༈ /gal te mngon gsal ②sbyor yin na/ /de ni gong du bsal zin to/ ༈ /gang las blo de gsal yin la/ /de ni 'bras bur gal te sbyor/ ༈ /smra ba po gsal rgyu yin pas/ /nyan pa po yang 'bras 'brel 'gyur①—/ ༈ /mngon par gsal min sgra dag gi0/ /byed pa rnams kyi sbyor ba 'am—/ /yid kyi bzlas pa don med 'gyur/ /sgra ni rna ba'i spyod yul yin/ ༈ /brgyud pas de las bskyed nyid phyir/ /blo de'ang gsal ba yin zhe na/ /gal te don can yin mi 'grub/ /rtog pa'i rjes su 'gro phyir ro/ /rang dang spyi yi rang bzhin rnams/ /ngo bo gcig tu rjobarjod 'dod nas/ /brda byed rnams kyis brjod pa'i phyir/ /mi 'gal dngos po la ma yin/ ༈ /gal te go rims med na ni/ /ro dang mtsho zhes thos pa las/ /'bras tha dad med 'gyur zhe na—/ ༈ /de ni skyes bu'i rten can yod/ /yi ge kun slong shes pa las/ /skyes la shes las rjosgra skye'o/ ༈ /de yi khyad par can de ni/ /rna bas nges par 'gyur ba yin/ ༈ /shes nges skyed dze+epa'i shes pa can/ ༈ /de thos myur min thos pa can—/ /de dran pa la ltos nas ni/ /phyis ni bdag nyid la dran byed/ ༈ /de ni rgyu dang 'dzin sems kyi/ /yig ⑧rnams rgyu dang 'bras bu yi⑨/ /go rims dag ni yin zhes brjod/ /de dag skyes bus byas pa nyid/ ༈ /de phyir yi ge'i ngo bo de/ /tshig dang tshig las ⑩gzhan nyid de/ /byed po'i 'du byed 97—496

las tha dad/ /lhan cig 'bras bus ①khyad par byed/ ༈ /yi ge rnams kyi go rims de'ang / /spel bar byed la 'jug yin te/ /'dod dang mi 'gal grub can gyi/ /go rims gnas pa 'gal phyir ro/ /skyes bu dang ni yi ge rnams/ /rgyu 'bras nyid du grub pa'i phyir/ /yi ge'i rim kun skyes bu las①/ /me dang shing gi rigs pa bzhin/ ༈ /shes mthu dag gis sngags zhes ①pa'i/ /go rims byed tshul can skyes bu/ /thun mong min pa nyid grub ste/ /gzhan la de dag med phyir ro/ ༈ /gang yang rgyud rig 'ga' zhig gis/ /gsang sngags 'ga' zhig byed 'gyur ba/ /de dag gis rjode gtso bo'i mthu/ /de dubashad rigs pa 'jug phyir ro/ /'bras bu 'dod pas sngags rnams ni/ /byas dang skyes bus byas brjod bya/ ༈ /skyes bu nus med sgrub byed ni/ /'di nyid kyis ni gsal dub yin/ /blo dbang smra dang skyes bu nyid/ /la sogs sgrub byed gang brjod pa/ /tshad ltar snang yin lhag ldan pas/ /ji bzhin don rtogs yod ma yinaske/ /sgra ni ngo bo ⑦'di don dang / /'di don min zhes rjod mi byed/ ༈ /skyes bus don 'di brtags pa ste/ /de yang 'dod chags la sogs ldan/ ༈ /de gcig de nyid rig ⑧gzhan min/ /khyad par yang ni su yis byas/ /de bzhin skyes nyid rnam 'gas kyang / /khyed ci shes ldan 'ga' mi 'dod/ ༈ /gal te gang tshig ⑨tshad ma yis⑩/ /mi slu de don rig yin na/ /shin tu skog tu gyur rnams la/ /tshad ma yod pa srid ma yin/ ༈ /gang gi tshig ni tshad ma yi⑪//mi slu de yis byas pa'i tshig⑫ /de lung zhes thob de yi phyir/ /skyes bus byas min don med yin/ /gal te shin tu sgog gyur don/ /lung med par ni shes srid na/ /dbang po las 'das don rig 'ga'/ /yod do zhes ni mngon 97—497

'dod 'gyur/ ༈ /bdag nyid 'dod chags sogs ldan pa'am/ /gzhan las rig byed don rig min/ /rig byed rig ①par byed min na/ /rig byed don ni gang las rtogs/ /des na mtho ris 'dod me la/ /sbyin sreg sbyin zhes thos pa las②/ /khye sha za ①zhes bya ba de/ /don min zhes 'di tshad ma gang / /'jig rten tshig rab grags she na/ /de la sna tshogs don can sgra'i/ /gang gi ④don 'di rnam dbye ba/ /dbang po las 'das don mthong gang / /grags min don brjod mtho ris gang / /lha mo la sogs sgra mthong ngo / /de 'dra'i sgra gzhan dag la ni/ /de 'dra'i rnam rtog nyid du 'gyur/ ༈ /grags pa dag kyang mi rnams tshig /de yang tshad mar mi 'dod na/ /sbar yang de las don rtogs pa—/ /sdang 'dod 'di ni ci zhig yin/ ༈ /gal te grags pa las 'gal ⑤ba'i/ /rtog la rgyu ci yod ce na/ /rab grags tshad ma nyid min phyir/ /der 'dzin pa la rjorgyu ci yod/ /grags pa nyid kyi sgra don gyi/ /nges la dogs pa bskyed ⑦pa ni//gang phyir de la sgra rnams don/ /sna tshogs 'jug pa can nyid mthong / /nges byed ma mthong ba dag gis⑧/ /sna tshogs nus can sgra rang nyid/ /nges par dogs pa sti'agyur ba ste/ /gzhan du mi srid med ⑩phyir ro/ ༈ /'ga' zhig lam ni 'di yin zhes/ /sdong dum 'di ni smra ⑪'gyur zhes/ /gzhan ni bdag nyid smra de ltar/ /de dag bye brag brtag par gyis/ ༈ /thams cad la rung don gcig gi/ /gsal byed nges pa gang las yin/ ༈ /brjod 'dod nges pa ma gtogs pa⑫/ /gang gis dbang po las 'das shes/ ༈ /brjod 'dod nges pa'i rgyu yin zhing / /brda ni de yi gsal byed yin/ ༈ /de ni skyes min la med narka/ /de don gcig can de gang las/ ༈ /rang bzhin kyis ni nges yin na/ /97—498

gzhan la des kyang mi rung ngo / /brda yang don rnged can nyid 'gyur/ /brda las rang bzhin khyad par gye/ /gsal ba'i nges pa gang las yin/ myu/ /gang la 'dod pa rang rgyud pa/ /de la nges pa zhes bya gang / /des na brda ni rung ba nyid/ /'dod pa kho na gsal mi 'gyur/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dag go // //①gang phyir rig byed phyogs gcig phyir/ /gzhan yang de 'dra snyeyin te dper / / mes grang bzlog 1dag bden pa bzhin/ /de skad gzhan dag zer ro lo/ /ro 'dra ngo bo mtshungs nyid phyir/ /snod gcig la yang tshos ༄pa bzhin / /lhag ldan 'khrul pa can nyid phyir/ /rig pa shes pas 'di 'dra bkag /skyes bu rtag pa byed po nyid/ /dngos rnams rtag dang dbang po 'das / /dbang bos 3gzung bya dang dngos rnams/ /rgyu dang gnas 'jig mi mnyam dang / /gzhan yang tshad ma rnams ⑥gnyis kyis/ /rnam par gsal ba'i spyod yul lam/ /lung la ltos pa rjes dpag dang / /'gal ba dag ni rjod byed pa/ /'gal ba kun tu ma bsal zhing / /bstan bcos ston 3 yang ma bstan la/ /de bden don bcas byekhas len pa/ /g.yem ma mu cor gyis rgyal lo—/ myu/ /gal te de ltar tshad grub na/ /'o na 'di la tshad min ci/ /skyes bu mang du smra ba la/ /bden pa'i don gcig rnged pa min/ /rjod ⑨pa po la sgra gnas pas/ /'di dngos rang bzhin nam 'bras min/ /'di las rnam par bzlog pas kyang / /'khrul pa med pa yod ma yin/ /rjod byed rnams kyis /— sna'ajug pa ni/ /brjod bya mthong bas byed ce na/ /phan tshun dag ni 'gal ba'i don/ /de ni gcig la ji ltar 'gyur/ ༈ /des na lung dang dngos po 97—499

rnams / /rtogs pa po yi ①rnam 'ga' yang / /med na mi 'byung mi 'grub na//de las don gang nges pa yin/ /de phyir de ni log na yang / /dngos po med par 'grub khyami 'gyur/ ༈ /des na med nges 'bras bu can/ /mi dmigs pas ni mi 'grub bo/ lha/ /rig byed tshad ma dang ni 'gal ④byed smra/ /khrus las chos 'dod dang ni rig byasmras dregs/ myu/ /sdig pa gzhom phyir gdung ba rtsom zhes pa/ /blun po shes rab 'chal ba'i rtags lnga yin/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las rang rngudon rjes su dpag pa ste le'u dang po'o// //tshad ma bslu zhwamed can shes pa/ /don byed nus par gnas pa ni/ /mi slu sgra las byung ba yang / /mngon par 'dod pa ston phyir ro/ ༈ /smra ba po yi byed pa'i yul/ /don gang blo la rab gsal ⑦ ba/ /de la sgra ni tshad ma nyid bye / /don gyi de nyid rgyu can min/ stsa/ /gzung ba 'dzin phyir kun rdzob ni/ /mi 'dod blo ni tshad ma nyid/ /blang dang dor bya'i dngos po yi/ /'jug la de gtso yin phyir dang / /yul rnam she7can ni tha dad pas/ /blo yi rtogs pa tha dad phyir/ /de yod na 'di yod phyir ro/ myu/ /rang las rang gi ngo bo rtogs/ /tha snyad las ni tshad ma nyid/ /bstan bcos rmongs pa zlog byed yin/ ༈ /ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang / /rang gi ngo bo rtogs 'og tu/ /spyi yi rnam par shes pa thob/ /rang gi mtshan nyid mi shes pa/ /shes pa gang yin zhes dgongs phyir / /rang gi mtshan nyid dpyad phyir ro/ myu/ /de ldan bcom ldan tshad ma nyid / myu/ /ma skyes pa ni bzlog don du/ /gyur pa nyid gsungs de yi phyir/ /sgrub byed la ltos tshad yin rigs/ ༈ /tshad ma rtag pa nyid yod min/ /dngos 97—500

yod rtogs pa tshad ①phyir dang / /shes bya mi rtag pa nyid kyis/ /de ni mi brtan ⑤nyid phyir ro/ /rim bzhin skye ba can dag ni/ /rtag las skye ba mi 'thad phyir/ /ltos pa mi rung ba yi phyir/ myu/ /rnam 'gas phan gdags bya min phyir—/ /mi rtag na yang tshad med nyid/ myu/ /sdod 'jug dbyibs kyi khyad par dang / /don byed pa la sogs pa dag /'dod pa grub pa'am dpe ma grub/ /yang na the tshom za ba yin/ myu/ /byin rlabs 1yod med rjes 'jug can/ /dbyibs sogs ci 'dra rab grub pa/ /de las rjes su dpog gang yin/ /de ni rigs pa nyid yin no/ /tha dad dngos la rab grub pa/ /sgra mtshungs rnyitha dad med pa'i ⑤phyir/ /rjes dpog rigs pa ma yin te/ /skye bo'i rdzas las me bzhin no/ myu/ /de lta min na rdza mkhan kyis/ /bum pa la sogs 'jim pa yi/ /rnam 'gyur 'ga' zhig byed pa'i phyir/ /grog mkhar yang des byas grub 'gyur/ lnga//bsgrub bya'i rjes 'gro phyir 'bras bu/ /spyis kyang sgrub par byed pa la/ /'byel pa can nyid tha dad phyir/ /tha dad skyon brjod 'bras mtshungs 'dod/ lnga/ /rigs kyi khyad par la grub pa/ /sgra yi spyi ni mthong ba las/ /sgrub byed mi rigs ngag la sogs/ /go nyid phyir na rwa can bzhin/ lnga/ /rjod 47par 'dod pa'i gzhan dbang phyir/ /sgra rnams gang la'ang med ma yin/ /de yod pas ni don grub na/ /thams cad kyis ni thams cad grub/ myu/ /'dis ni ser skya la sogs kyi/ /mi rtag sogs phyir yang sems med/ /sogs dang shun pa bshus na ni/ /'chi phyir sems ldan dpyad pa yin/ myu/ /dngos po'i ngo bo ma grub na/ /tshul 'di grub na ma grub kyang / /khyad par gnod byed ma yin te/ /sgra yi nam mkha' la brten bzhin/ /sgra ma grub kyang dngos po ni/ /grub na grub par 97—501

'gyur te dper/ /'ug pa pa rmyel sangs rgyas pas/ /lus sogs sgrub byed bshad pa bzhin/ /de nyid 'khrul la sogs yin na/ /sgra ni 'khrul pa med na yang / /sgrub byed skyon ldan shes 1bya ste/ /dngos las dngos po 1grub phyir ro//'gro ba'i phyir dang lag ldan phyir/ /rwa can glang po zhes sgrub byed/ /'di yi sgra yi brjod bya ni/ /grags pa ④yin gyes brjod 'dod min/ ༈ /ji ltar dngos de rgyu yin pa/ /de lta de nyid gang gi tshe/ /rgyu min gang gis de ni rgyur/ /'dod la rgyu ma yin mi 'dod/ lnga/ /mtshon dang sman sogs 'byel pa las/ /nag pa'i rma dang 'drubs yin na/ /'brel med sdong dum ci yi phyir/ /rgyu nyid du ni rtog 3mi byed/ /rang bzhin khyad par med par ni/ /byed par yang ni mi rung ngo / myu/ /rtag la ldog pa med pa'i phyir/ /nus pa nyid kyang rtogs par dka'/ myu/ /gang dag yod na gang 'gyur nyid/ /de dag las gzhan de yi rgyu 67 / /rtog pa yin na thams cad la/ /rgyu rnams thug pa med par 'gyur/ lnga/ /myu gu skyed skyel sa la sogs/ /rang bzhin yongs su gyur nas kyeni/ /rgyu yin de legs byas pa na/ /de yi khyad par mthong phyir ro/ stsa/ /gal te ji ltar yul dbang po/ /tshogs pa khyad med blo rgyu yin/ /de ltar 'di yin zhe na min/ /de las 9snakhyad par yod phyir ro/ /so so rmye so sor nus med rnams/ /rang bzhin khyad par med pas na/ /tshogs kyang nus pa med 'gyur bas/ /de phyir khyad par grub pa yin/ /de phyir so sor gang nus med/ /tshogs na yon tan srid 'gyur ba/ /de dag rgyu yin dbang phyug sogs/ /ma yin khyad par med phyir ro/ myu/ /tshad ma sgog gyur don shes yin/ /de sgrub byed kyang med pa'i phyir//nan tan byed pa yod ma yin/ /zhes ni kha cig rab tu brjod/ /mi shes ston 97—502

par byed pa la/ /'khrul par dogs pa can rnams kyis/ /des bshad nan tan bya ba'i phyir/ /shes ldan 'ga' zhig tshol bar byed/ /de phyir de yin hūṃbasgrub bya ru/ /gyur pa'i ye shes rnam dpyad bya'i47/ /'di yis srin bu'i grangs mkhyen pa/ /nged la 'gar yang nyer mkho rnged/ lnga/ /blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni/ /thabs dang bcas pa rigs ldumadzad pa/ /gang de tshad ma nyid 'dod kyi④/ /thams cad rigs chomadzad ma yin no/ /ring po mthong ba'am min yang rung / /'dod pa'i de hūṃnyid mthong ba yin/ lnga/ /gal te ring mthong tshad yin na/ /tshur shog bya rgod bsten par gyes/ lnga/ /sgrub byed thugs rjes goms las de/ ༈ /blo ni lus la brten pa'i phyir/ /goms pas grub pa med ce na/ myu/ /ma yin rten hūṃ ni bkag phyir ro/ /skye ba yongs su len pa na/ /'byung rngub dbang po blo dag ni/ /rang gi rigs la ltos med can/ /lus nyid 'ba' zhig las skye min/ /ha cang thal phyir mtshams sbyor bar/ /nus ldan mthong ba gang de la/ /ci zhig yod 'gyur ke gang med pa/ /gang gis phyi nas mtshams sbyor med/ myu/ /gang du drod gsher la sogs pa/ /skye bo skye bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /sa sogs cha de 'ga' yang med/ /de phyir thams cad sa bon bdag /de phyir dbang sogs rang rigs la/ /ltos pa med par 'byung yin na/ /ji ltar gcig ni yongs 'gyur bzhin/ /kun 'gyur khyad par med phyir ro/ ༈ /dbang rnams re re la gnod na/ /yid blo la gnod yod ma yin/ /'di 'gyur na ni de dag kyang / /'gyur ba dag tu mthong ba yin/ myu/ /de phyir blo gnas pa yi rten/ /blo nyid la ni brten pa 'ga'/ /dbang po rnams kyi rgyu yin pas/ /de phyir blo las dbang po yin/ /de 'dra'i 'phen byed yod gyur na//97—503

phyis kyang de 'drar 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi shes pas phan 'dogs phyir/ /yid ni lus la brten par bshad/ /gal te dbang po med par blo/ /ma yin de yang de med par/ /de lta'ang phan tshun rgyu nyid pas/ /de phyir phan tshun rgyu can yin/ myu/ /rim can min las rim can min/ /khyad par can min ltos pa'ang med/ lnga/ /lus las rim gyis blo 'gyur na/ myu/ /de'i yang rim pa gsal bar byed/ lnga/ /skad cig snga ma snga ma ni/ /skad cig re re sngon med de'i/ /rgyu yin de yi phyir na 1rgyu/ /thams cad tshe na mthong ba nyid/ myu/ /tha ma'i sems ni sems gzhan dang / /mtshams spyor ba la 'gal ci yod/ /dgra bcom sems gang yin de yang / /gang las mtshams sbyor med par 'dod/ lnga/ /tshad mas ma grub don can gyildu/ /grub mtha'i rjes su 'brang ngam ci/ /gal te de rgyu bral phyir na/ /de nyid 'dir ni cis ma brjod/ /de blo bzhin du 'dzin 'gyur phyir/ /dbang po bcas las yid shes min/ /shes skyed 1nus pa tha dad phyir/ /kun las kyang ni ma yin no/ /sems med nyid phyir gzhan las min / /rgyu gcig phyir na lhan cig gnas/ /dbang bzhin gzugs dang ro bzhin no/ /don kyi sgo nas 'gyur ba yin/ lnga/ /rtag tu de yi rjes 'jug phyir/ /gang zhig yod pas phan 'dogs byed/ /de rgyu de phyir bdun pa dang / /skyes phyir zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /'ga' zhig tshe na sems rgyun la/ /phan 'dogs byed pa'ang ceyin be+e ste/ /bum sogs la ni me sogs bzhin/ /de tsam gyis ni sdog snyepa min/ myu/ /lus ni gnas pa nyid na sems/ /ldog pa med par thal bar 'gyur/ myu/ /de yod yod dang dbang gyur ḍo67phyir/ /de las 'byung rngub de ma yin/ /rlung 'byin pa dang 'dren pa ni/ /'bad rtsol med par gang las 97—504

yin / myu/ /de dag yul byung 'grib pa las/ /phul byung 'grib pa thob par 'gyur / /de dag la yang thal ba mtshungs/ /sems rgyu yin na mtshungs ma yin / /gnas pa'i 'phen byed gzhan dag kyang / /gang phyir rgyu ni yin par 'dod / myu/ /gal te sdong bu la sogs bzhin/ /nyes pas mi mthun lus rgyu min / myu/ /shi bas nyes pa nyams gyur ①tshe/ /slar yang 'tsho ba dag tu 'gyur/ stsa//gal te me ni ldog na yang / /shing gi 'gyur ba mi ldog bzhin/ /de ni ldog pa med ce na/ myu/ /ma yin gso spyor yod phyir ro/ lnga/ /slar mi 'byung bar 'ga' zhig ni/ /la lar 'gyur ba skyed 37par byed/ /'ga' zhig sdog napa yin phyir dper—/ /shing dang gser la me bzhin no/ /dang po chung yang ldog pa min/ /slar ldog rung bar 'gyur byas ④gang / /de ni slar yang 'byung 'gyur te/ /gser gyi sra ba nyid bzhin no/ /cung zad gso bya min brjod pa/ lnga/ /'chos byed rnyed par byedaka' phyir ram/ /tshe zad phyir ro nyes 'ba' zhig /yin na gso min med pa gnyis⑥/ /shi ba'i dug sogs ldog phyir ram/ /de yi sos zin bcad las kyang / /'gyur ba'i rgyu dang bral bas na/ /de cis be+er yang 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /nyer len 'gyur ba med par ni/ /nyer len can dag 'gyur bar ni/ /byed par mi nus dper 'jim pape/ /'gyur ba med par bum sogs bzhin/ myu/ /dngos gang 'gyur ba med par ni/ /dngos po gang zhig rnam 'gyur ba/ /de de'i nyer len mi rigs te/ /ba glang ba men la sogs bzhin/ /sems dang lus kyang de bzhin no/ lnga/ /de rgyu lhan cig byed pa las / /skye ba'i 'bras bu lhan cig gnas/ /me dang zangs ma'i zhu nyid bzhin / myu/ /yod med dag la rten (shemed phyir/ /ma yin yod pa'i gnas rgyu ni/ /97—505

rten yin zhes na 'di rten ①med/ /gnas pa po las gzhan min phyir/ /gzhan yin na yang de rgyu nyid/ /des ni dngos po ci zhig byas/ ༈ /'jigs ⑦pa med par thal bar 'gyur/ ༈ /gal te de 'jig rgyu las 'dod/ /de la'ang thal ba snematshungs pa yin/ /gnas pa'i rgyus kyang ci zhig byas/ /gal te 'jig rgyu phrad bar du/ /des gnas 'jig pa dngos chos nyid/ /yod pa 'di gnod med phyir dang du/ /gnas pa'i rgyus ni ci zhig bya/ /gal te dper na chu sogs kyi/ /rten bzhin zhe na 'di la'ang mtshungs/ /dngos rnams ⑤skad cig re rer ni/ /'jig na dngos rgyun dude lta bur/ /skye rgyu yin phyir de rten yin—/ /de lta min na rigs ma yin/ ༈ /'bo ba yis ⑦ni gegs byed phyir/ /chu sogs kyi ni rten 'gyur gyi/ /'gro ba med can yon tan spyi/ /las rnams la ni rten ci dgos/ /'dis ni 'phrod pa 'du ba dang / /'phrod pa 'du ba can rgyu dang / /rigs la sogs pa rnam ⑧gnas nyid/ /rten med phyir na gsal ⑨ba yin/ ༈ /gal te gzhan las dngos 'jig na/ /de yi gnas rgyus ci zhig bya/ /de gzhan med par 'jig na yang / /gnas pa'i rgyu rnams nus med yin/ ༈ /rten bcas thams cad gnas ldan dang / /skye ba can kun rten bcas yin/ /de phyir dngos po thams cad ni/ /'ga' zhig tshe na'ang 'jig mi 'gyur/ ༈ /gal te rang 'jig ngang tshul bdag /yin na de gnas byed gzhan gang / /gal te rang 'jig ngang tshul bdag /min na de gnas byed gzhan gang / ༈ /lus kyi phul byung 'grib med par/ /blo yi byed pa'i khyad par gyis/ /shes rab la sogs phul byung dang / /'grib pa dag tu 'gyur ba yin—/ ༈ /'di ni mar me'i 'od la sogs/ /rten ⑩pa rnams la yod ma yin/ ༈/97—506

de las kyang 'di khyad 'gyur te/ /sems la phan 'dogs med par min/ /'ga' tshe chags sogs rgyas sogs kyi/ /'phel ba bde sdug las skyes yin/ /de yang khams snyoms la sogs pa/ /nang gi don ni nye ba las/ /'dis ni 'dus pa la sogs pa①/ /dran pa nyams sogs bshad pa yin/ /nang don khyad par las skyes pa'i/ /blos ni 'gyur bar byed phyir ro/ ༈ /dper rgyud khyad par 'ga' zhig la/ /stag nyid dang ni khrag la sogs/ /thos pa dang ni mthong ba las/ /rmongs pa la sogs 'byung 'gyur bzhin/ ༈ /de phyir nges par gang nyid kyi/ /'du byed kyis ④ni rjes 'jug pa'i/ /sems ni de med mi 'byung ba/ /de phyir sems la brten pa yin/ ༈ /ji ltar sems la brten byas nas—/ /thos sogs 'du byed sems la ni/ /dus gsal tha dad med pa'i phyir—/ /de ltar lus la dze+eyon tan 'gyur/ /bdag la chags pa dang ldan pas/ /sems can gzhan gyis bkri min par/ /bde sdug der thob 'dod pas na/ /dman pa'i gnas rjoni yongs su len/ ༈ /sdug bsngal phyin ci log blo dang / /sred pa kun nas 'ching ba ni/ /skye rgyu gang la de med pa/ /de ni skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ ༈ /gal te 'gro 'ong ma mthong na/ /dbang po mi gsal phyir ma mthong / /dper na mig mi gsal ba yis/ /du ba chung ngu mi mthong bzhin/ ༈/lus can yin yang phra ba'i phyir/ /'ga' zhig la lar thogs med de/ /chu bzhin gser la dngul chu bzhin/ /ma mthong phyir na med pa min/ ༈ /lag sogs g.yo na thams cad dag /g.yo bar 'gyur phyir 'gal ba can/ ༈ /las ni gcig la mi rung phyir/ /gzhan du tha dad grub par 'gyur/ ༈ /gcig bsgribs pa na thams cad dag /bsgribs par 'gyur ba'am ma bsgribs na/ /97—507

mthong 'gyur gcig tshon gyis bsgyur na/ /bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur rtogs par 'gyur—/ ༈ /de phyir tshogs pa gcig yod min/ ༈ /du ma nyid na snga ma bzhin//khyad med phyir dang phra rab phyir/ /rtogs min zhe na khyad med par/ /ma grub khyad par can rnams ni/ /dbang yul de phyir rdul phran min/ /'dis ni sgrib byed la sogs pa/ /rnged pa dag kyang bsal ba yin/ ༈ /dngul chu gser sdedang 'dres pa'am/ /rdo tshon sdel sogs ji ltar snang / ༈ /dbang sogs so sor nus med rnams/ /rtogs pa dag ni ji ltar yin/ /ldan las zhe na 'dir thal mtshungs/ /gal te gser dang dngul chu ni/ /ldan pas snang ba yin zhe na/ /rten mthong med par gang las rtogs/ /ro gzugs la sogs ldan par 'gal/ /gal te nye bar btags pa las/ /'dod na blo tha dad par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'phreng ring zhes byar 'gyur/ /de ldan rang gi ngo bo dang / /brjod pa dag las tha dad par/ /grangs ldan las la sogs pa yi/ /ngo bo blo la mi snang ngo / ༈ /sgra shes dngos po tha dad pa'i/ /rjes 'brang rnam rtog btags ①don can/ /dper na yon tan la sogs pa④/ /zhig dang ma skyes dag la bzhin/ /gal te 'dir ni btags ⑤'dod na/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis de 'dod pa/ /de ni dngos po thams cad la/ /de dag gi rgyus cis mi 'dod—/ ༈ /gal te kun la nyer btags rjomin/ /tha dad khyad par gtso bo zhes—/ /bya nyid gang las tha dad pa/ /med la tha dad don med na/ /don gzhan rgyu mtshan can min yang / /dkar la sogs pa grangs sogs dang / /ldan pa'i sgra ni rnam grangs min/ /gal te de la'ang don gzhan na/ /yon tan rdzas ni khyad med 'gyur/ ༈ /don gzhan min yang ldog pa yi/ /dbye bas 97—508

tha dad pa yin te/ /las rdzas min pa'i sgra bzhin no/ ༈ /dngos po brjod pa'i sgra rnams kyis/ /grangs sogs de dang ①ldan pa las/ /tha dad bzhin du bstan gang de'ang / /chos gzhan khyad par byed pa yin/ ༈ /de tsam shes par 'dod pa la/ /gzhan kun 'phangs pa med par ni/ /la lar sor mo'i ldan pa zhes/ /tha dad chos bzhin rjod par byed/ /don gcig brjod kyang thams cad ni/ /'phen phyir sor mo ldan 'gyur zhes/ /chos can brjod par grags yin te/ /de ltar brdar ni byas pa yin/ /gzugs sogs nus pa'i khyad par ni//spong bas de mtshungs 'bras bu yi/ /rgyu min pa ni rnam gcod la/ /bum pa'i sgra ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /des na bum pa gzugs so zhes/ /gzhi gcig pa can sgra ma yin/ ༈ /des na 'di ni rigs dang ni/ /tshogs pa brjod pa'i khyad par yin/ /de spyi yan lag tu byas te/ /bum pa yi ni gzugs sogs zhes②—/ /de nus khyad par ston par byed/ ༈ /phyogs 'dis gzhan la'ang brjod par bya/ ༈ /ma lus rgyu nyid yin na ni/ /yan lag gcig dang bral na'ang min/ /re re nus pa nyid yin na'ang / /cig car mang po 'byung bar 'gyurasne| ༈ /du ma nyid du mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /'byung rngub dag ni nges byed min—/ ༈ /gcig nyid na yang mang gsal 'gyur/ /de rgyu rtag tu nye phyir ro/ ༈/gal te du ma'i rgyu min na/ /rim byis kyang dhimin khyad med phyir/ ༈ /dbugs gcig la yang don du ma/ /'dzin phyir de las nges ma yin/ /du ma blo gcig gis shes na/ /de ni cig car nyid 'gyur te/ /'gal ba med phyir rim gyis kyang / /mi 'gyur khyad par med phyir ro/ ༈ /rang rigs ⑤min pa'i dus can gyi/ /dbugs kyi skad cig mang po dag /gal te de 'dra'i sems 97—509

nyid kyi/ /rgyu yin par ni rtogs ①byed na/ /go rims ldan pa'i rgyu med par/ /de dag rim ldan ji ltar 'gyur/ ༈ /rang rigs snga ma rgyu nyid na/ ༈ /dang po 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /de rgyu de 'dra yod ma yin/ /dbugs 'byung tha dad yul can phyir/ /yod kyang du ma nyid du nges/ /de phyir blo ni cig car skye/ ༈/gal te du ma'ang gcig dus can/ /sems gcig gi ni rgyu yin na/ ༈ /dbugs rgyu zhan pa la sogs su/ /gcig ma tshang na'ang mi 'byung 'gyur/ /ci ste ji ltar yod rgyu yin/ /shes pa la yang khyad yod 'gyur/ /gang zhig gang gi ①tha dad las/ /tha dad min de ①de 'bras min/ ༈ /rnam shes nus pa nges pa'i phyir—/ /gcig ni gcig gi rgyu yin te/ /rnam shes don gzhanalgechags pa yis/ /nus med don gzhan ⑤mi 'dzin phyir/ /gal te lus las cig car blo/ /skyes shing phyis ni rang rig las/ /nges na lus kyis rjonus pa ni/ /ci yi phyir na ldog pa yin/ /gal te lus ni ldog pa na/ /rten min phyir na sems 'ba' zhig /gnas 'gyur zhe na gal te de'i/ /rgyu 'jug thob phyir sems kyi rgyun/ /gnas rgyu yan lag mi 'gyur na/ ༈ /tshe 'di nyid kyi skye mched lnga/ /lus gzhan skyed ⑦pa'i rgyu nyid yin/ ༈ /de yi ⑧yan lag dngos po dang / /rgyu nyid 'gog la mi ⑨dmigs pa/ /nges 'byed ⑩min par rab tu bshad/ /dbang sogs kyang ni lhag ldan yin/ /dbang po snga ma rang rigs las/ /nus pa dag ni mthong ba yin/ ༈ /'gyur ba mthong phyir gzhan dang gzhan/ /skye ba dag kyang 'grub pa ⑪nyid/ ༈ /gal te lus las de skye na/ /snga ma bzhin du thal bar 'gyur/ ༈ /sems las zhe na lus gzhan yang / /'di nyid las ni skye bar 'gyur/ /des na rgyu dang bral ⑩ba'i phyir/ /tha ma yi ni sems rnams 97—510

kun—/ /mtshams sbyor med pa min de'i phyir/ /de 'dra'i sgrub byed lhag ldan 'dod| ༈ /goms las khyad par 'gyur na yang / /mchongs dang chu yi drod ①bzhin du/ /rang bzhin las 'das min zhe na/ /byas te gal te slar yang ni/ /'bad rtsol la ni ltos 'gyur ram/ /rten mi brtan pa nyid 'gyur na/ /khyad par dag ni mi 'phel na/ /rang bzhin de 'dra'ang ②ma yin te/ ༈ /de la phan 'dogs nus pa rnams/ /khyad par phyi ma dag la ni/ /sgrub pa'i nus pa med phyir dang / /rtag tu rten gnas ma yin phyir/ /khyad par 'phel yang rang bzhin nyid/ /min phyir gang tshe byas gyur pa/ /yang rtsol la ltos mi 'gyur na/ /rtsol gzhan khyad par byed par 'gyur/ ༈ /sems la brtse ①sogs goms skye ba/ /rang gi ngang gis 'jug 'gyur te/ /me la sogs pas shing dag dang / /dngul chu dang ni gser sogs bzhin/ ༈ /de phyir de dag las skyes terjo/ /ngo bo nyid skyes yon tan min⑤/ ༈ /des na rtsol ba phyi ma dang / /phyi ma khyad par dubyed pa yin/ /gang phyir rigs mthun snga ma yi/ /sa bon las ni 'phel ba can / /brtse ba la sogs blo de dag /goms par gyur na gang la ⑦gnas/ ༈/de ltar mchongs nyid la ⑧mchongs min/ /de ⑨rgyu stobs dang 'bad rtsol dag /nus pa nges pa nyid kyi phyir/ /mchongs pa nges pa'i bdag nyid yin/ ༈ /de ni dang po phyis nyid ⑩du/ /mchongs min lus mi mthun pa'i phyir/ /rtsol bas rim gyis mi mthun pa/ /bsal na rang stobs nyid du gnas/ ༈ /brtse rang sa bon las byung ba/ /gal te rang sa bon rgyu can/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis gnod med na/ /sems la de bdag nyid du 'gyur/ /'di ltar goms pa snga ma dang / /snga ma'i sems chos brtse ba dang / /chags bral blo sogs gzhan 97—511

dag gi/ /gsal ba yi ni rtsa ba yin/ ༈ /goms las brtse ba'i bdag nyid de/ /chags bral chags dang yid log bzhin/ ༈ /brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i phyir—/ /thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor mdzad/ /thabs byung de rgyu sgog gyur pa—/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ ༈ /lung dang rig pas rnam dpyod pa/ /sdug bsngal nyid kyi khyad par gyis/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de mi rtag /la sogs rang bzhin rtog ①par mdzad/ /gang phyir de ltar rgyu gnas na/ /'bras ldog ②gzigs pa med phyir ro/ ༈ /de rgyu gzhom phyir de yi nipe/ /mi mthun phyogs la brtag pa mdzad/ /rgyu yi ngo bo rtogs pa'i phyir/ /de mi mthun phyogs kyang nges 'gyur/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin byas pa/ /'dus byas spyod yul can chags ni/ /rgyu yin de yi gnod byed ni/ /bdag med mthong ba 'gal ba yin/ ༈ /rnam pa du mar thabs mang po/ /yun ring dus su goms pa las/ /de la skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu gsal ba nyid du 'gyur/ ༈ /des na thugs kyang gsal ba'i phyir/ /rgyu yi bag chags spangs pa yin/ ༈ /thub chen gzhan don 'jug can gyi/ /bse ru la sogs khyad 'di yin/ ༈ /de don phyir na thabs goms pa/ /de nyid ston pa yin par 'dod/ /grub las dang po 'byung ba'i phyir/ /gnyis po 'di ni rgyu ru bshad/ ༈ /rgyu spangs yon tan gsum bde gshegs/ /nyid yin sdug bsngal rten min phyir/ /legs yin de ni bdag med pa/ /mthong ba'am sbyor ba las yin no/ /skye dang skyon ni kun 'byung dag /slar yang ldog ces bshad pa yin/ /bdag lta'i sa bon spangs pa'i phyir/ /slar mi gshegs pa nyid yin no/ /de bden tha dad bdag nyid kyis—/ ༈ /lus ngag sems kyi gnas ngan len/ /nyon mongs med dang nad 97—512

med dang / /lam bshad mi gsal nyid lus yin①/ /goms phyir ma lus spangs pa nyid/ ༈ /kha cig smra sogs phyir na skyon/ /zad min zhes zer 'di ldog la/ /the tshom za ba de phyir 'khrul/ /rtag nyid phyir ram thabs med phyir/ /yang na thabs ni mi shes phyir/ /skyon rnams mi zad pa nyid ces/ /bya bar yongs su rtog grang na/ ༈ /rgyu yod phyir dang rgyu yi ni/ /gnyen po goms pas zad phyir dang / /rgyu yi rang bzhin shes pa yis/ /de shes pa yang grub pa yin/ ༈/skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsungs pa④/ /'bras med phyir na brdzun mi gsung //thugs brtse ldan phyir rtsom kun yang / /gzhan gyi don du spyor phyir ro/ /de phyir tshad yin yang na skyob/ /bden pa bzhi ni ston mdzad pa'o/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ /goms las 'dod chags sogs gsal ba/ /mthong phyir 'dod ⑦rgyal nyid min te/ /rgyu med skye ba 'gal phyir ro/ /'khrul phyir rlung sogs chos ma yin/ /gal te rang bzhin 'dres pa'i phyir/ /skyon med ce na de yi chos/ /de las gzhan yang cis ma mthong / /thams cad 'dod chags mtshungs par ni/ /thal phyir kun gyi chos ma yin/ /gzugs sogs bzhin skyon med ce na/ /gal te de la khyad par can/ /las rnams bdag po ma yin na/ /der yang rtsod pa mtshungs pa yin/ /dhichags sogs rang bzhin thams cad kyi/ /chos yin par yang 'dod na go/ /nus med rang bzhin med pas na/ /'bras bu mi mtshungs gang las yin/ /skyon rnams khyad par yod na yang / /khyad par med phyir ma grub nyid/ /ma yin thams cad 'gyur ba yis/ /'gyur phyir kun las skye ba'ang min/ /rgyu ni 'phel bar gyur pa na/ /'bras bu 'grib par mi rung ste/ /tsha ba sogs bzhin chags sogs kyi/ /97—513

'gyur ba bde sdug las skyes yin/ /cha mi mnyam skyes sdug bsngal gyis/ /gal te 'dod chags mi skyed ①na/ ༈ /cis skyed ①spros shig cha mnyam las/ /khya 'phel de las 'dod chags yin/ ༈ /cha mi mnyam la chags can mthong / /gzhan ni cha mnyam na yang min/ /gzhan ni zad nas khrag 'dzag sdekyang / ༈ /bud med gcig la khu nges med/ /de gcig la chags drag mi 'gyur/ /gal te gzugs sogs kyang yan lag /ma yin kun ma nges phyir ro/ /nges pa med par 'byung rjoba'ang min/ /yon tan mi 'dzin pa la'ang 'gyur/ /gal te yon tan 'dzin de yang / /yan lag yin na thams cad kyis/ /yon tan 'dzin pa can 'gyur te/ /rgyu la khyad par med phyir ro/ ༈ /gnas skabs gang la chags can 'dod/ /de 'dra zhe sdang can mi 'gyur/ /de gnyis ngo bo mi mtshungs phyir/ /'di la nges par mthong ba'ang med/ /gang gi 'dod chags la sogs pa/ /rigs mthun bag chags khyad par la/ /rag las pas ⑤ni 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de la skyon 'dir thal ba med/ ༈ /'dis ni 'byung ba'i chos nyid bkag ༈ /rten yang bkag pa nyid phyir ro/ /dkar po la sogs sa sogs la/ /brten pa nyid ni ma yin no/ ༈ /de rten sgra yang rgyu don nam/ /yang rjon rang gi rten dag dang / /dbyer med par ni gnas pa'i phyir/ /rten yin gzhan du 'thad ma yin/ /gal te myos sogs nus pa bzhin/ /dbyer yod ce na dngos po las/ /nus pa don gzhan nyid ma yin/ /dngos po 'jig 'gyur rten chad par/ /gnas na rten ⑦pa 'jig pa yin/ /gal te de mtshungs zhe na min/ /snang ba tha dad can rtogs ⑧pas/ /'byung sems tha dad nyid phyir ro/ /ji srid lus ni 'gyur bar du/ /gzugs sogs bzhin du 97—514

yid ngo bo/ /mtshungs 'gyur rnam par rtog pa ni/ /don gye gzhan dbang can nyid gang / /gang tshe lus la ltos med par/ /shes pa 'ga' zhig 'ga' zhig gis① / /bag chags sad pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba/ /des na 'ga' zhig las 'ga' yin/ /rnam shes min pa rnam shes kyi/ /nyer ②len min pa'i phyir yang 'grub①ske/ ༈ /gal te dngos po thams cad ni/ /rnam shes nus ldan phyir 'dod na/ ༈ /rtsa rjosogs rtse na glang chen brgya/ /sngon tshe ma mthong yod do zhes//de skad grangs can phyugs las gzhan/ /ngo mtshar bcas pa su brjod rtsol/ ༈ /rgyu ni lan brgyar rnam phye yang / /ngo bo gang zhig snang gyur pa'i/ /ngo bo de ni sngar mi snang / /ji ltar de ni yod par 'gyur/ /snga na med pa 'byung ba las⑤//chags sogs nges med thal bar 'gyur/ ༈ /'byung ba'i bdag las ma 'das phyir—/ /gal te kun chags sogs ldan na/ ༈ /thams cad 'dod chags mtshungs par 'gyur/ ༈ /gal te 'byung khyad dulas yin na/ /'byung rnams srog ⑦chags khyad med kyang / ༈ /khyad par 'di rten gang yin pa/ /de ni phul byung 'grib pa bzhin/ /de yod pa las de med 'gyur/ ༈ /gal te chags sogs tha dad kyang / /rgyu mtshungs ④bdag nyid mi ldog phyir/ /min na bdag nyid 'dra rgyu'i phyir/ /kun la 'dod chags 'dra bar 'gyur/ ༈ /mtshungs bdag las byung ba glang gi/ /shes pa'am 'dir yang sa sogs la/ /srog chags nyid sogs khyad par gyi/ /rim pa la lar yod ma yin/ ༈ /dro rim khyad par yod na yang / /dro ⑨med me 'ga' yod min pa/ /de bzhin 'dir yang zhe na min/ /dro las me gzhan bkag phyir ro/ ༈ /gang zhig gzhan yod yon tan ni/ /khyad par rim pa dang ldan pa/ /de dag de yi khyad par ni/ /97—515

la lar 'chad ①'gyur dkar sogs bzhin/ /gzugs sogs bzhin du nges min te/ /de dag 'byung dang dbyer med phyir/ ༈ /gal te de mtshungs she na min—/ /chags sogs lhan cig skyes thal phyir/ ༈ /rnam par brtags sdepa yul yin phyir/ /yul yang nges byed ma yin no/ /skal mnyam rgyu dang bral ba'i phyir/ /chags sogs nges pa med pa 'am/ ༈ /rgyu ni nye phyir blo rnams kun//thams cad kun tshe skye bar 'gyur/ ༈ /de ni res 'ga' dmigs pa'i phyir/ /mi rtag nyes pa'i rten phyir dang / /rgyu dbang phyir yang sdug bsngal yin/ /bdag min byen gyis brlabs ④pa'ang min/ /rgyu min byen gyis rlob pa min/ ༈/rtag pa ji ltar skyed byed yin/ /de phyir gcig las du ma ni/ /dus tha dad par skye mi 'gyur/ ༈ /rgyu gzhan dag ni tshogs na yang / /'bras bu skye ba med pa'i phyir/ /rgyu gzhan rjes su dpog 'gyur rjon/ /de ni rtag rnams la yod min/ /res 'ga' ba nyid yin pas na/ /sdug bsngal nyid ⑤rgyu bcas nyid grub/ /rgyu med gzhan la mi ltos phyir/ /rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur / ༈ /ji ltar tsher ma la sogs kyi/ /rna dub nyid sogs rgyu med pa/ /de ltar 'di dag rgyu med 'gyur/ /zhes ni kha cig rab tu brjod/ /gang yod nyid na'ang gang skye ba'am/ /gang 'gyur na yang rnam 'gyur ba/ /de ni de ⑦rgyu rab tu brjod/ /de ni de ④rnams la yang yod/ /reg pa gzugs rgyu nyid yin phyirarka/ /mthong ba la ni rgyu mtshan yin/ /rtag rnams bkag cing dbang phyug laske/ /sogs pa las kyang srid min te/ /nus med phyir ro de yi phyir/ /srid 'dod rgyu yin gang gi phyir/ /mi rnams yul gyi khyad par ni⑫/ /yongs 'dzin de thob bsam pas byas/ ༈ /de ni srid 'dod gang phyir yang / /srog 97—516

chags bde sdug thob pa dang / /'dor 'dod 'jug pa de dag ni/ /'dod dang 'jig sred yin par 'dod/ /bdag tu chags pa'i rgyu nyid las/ /bde min bde bar 'du shes pas/ /kun la rab tu 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de phyir sred pa srid rten yin/ /chags bral skye ba ma mthong phyir/ /zhes ni slob dpon rnams kyis gsungs/ /lus med chags pa ma mthong phyir/ /lus las kyang ni 'dod chags 'byung / ༈ /rgyu mtshan khas blangs phyir na 'dod/ ༈ /nyer len nyid ni bsal ba yin/ ༈ /rigs 'di rjes su 'dod na ni/ /rang nyid rang 'dod la gnod 'gyur/ /gal te skye la chags mthong phyir/ /skye dang lhan cig 'byung zhe na/ /skal mnyam skye phyir sngar grub yin/ ༈ /mi shes srid pa'i rgyu yin yang / /ma brjod srid ①pa nyid bshad pa/ / rgyun ni 'phen pa ②byed phyir dang / /de ma thag phyir las kyang min/ /de yod na yod med phyir ro/ ༈/de ni gtan du ba ①yin te/ /rgyu la gegs sogs srid phyir ro/ /'khor phyir thar pa med ce na/ /ma yin 'dod dang ma grub phyir/ /ji srid bdag chags ④ma bcom zhing / /de ni yongs su gdung 'gyur ba/ /de srid sdug bsngal sgro btags nas/ /rang bzhin du ni gnas pa med/ /grol ba po ni med na yang / /log par sgro 'dogs ⑤gzhom phyir brtsonarjo/ ༈ /'dod chags bral ba'i gnas pa ni/ /brtse ba'am yang na las kyis yin/ /'phangs las ⑦ldog med 'dod phyir ro/ /srid pa'i sred las rnam brgal ba'i/ /las gzhan 'phen nus ma yin te/ /lhan cig byed pa zad phyir ro/ ༈ /sdug bsngal shes la 'gal med pas/ /'du byed snga ma 'jug pa can/ /dngos chos brtse ba skye ba de⑧/ /sems can rjes 'brel can ma yin/ ༈ /de bdag ⑨min pa'i chos 97—517

la ni/ /bdag gzhan sgo 'dogs pa las chags/ /sdug bsngal rgyun rig tsam las ni/ /brtse ba skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ ༈ /gnyi mug nyes pa'i rtsa ba ste/ /de yang sems can 'dzin pa yin/ /de med nyes rgyu las khro min/ /des na brtse ba nyes med 'dod/ ༈ /grol med ma yin mngon 'du ①byed/ /zad nas gzhan mtshams mi sbyor phyir/ ༈ /'du byed nus pa ma zad na/ /gang de gnas pa nyes med nyid②/ ༈ /snying rje dman pa nyid phyir yang / /gnas pa'i 'bad rtsol chen po med/ /gang dag brtse ba chen po pa/ /gzhan gyi ngor ni bzhugs pa yin/ /gal te 'jig tshogs lta bral phyir/ /lam dang por ni srid med 'gyuraske/ /lhan cig skyes pa ma spangs phyir/ /spangs na'ang srid pa ga la yod//bde bar gyur pa'am sdug bsngal bar/ /ma gyur cig ces 'dod pa na/ /nga'o snyam pa'i blo gang de/ /sems can la blta ①lhan cig skyes/ ༈ /nga zhes mthong ba med par ni/ /'ga' yang bdag la chags ma yin/ /bdag la sred dupa med par yang / /bde ba 'dod pas mngon rgyug min/ ༈ /sdug bsngal skye ba'i rgyu nyid ni/ /'ching yin rtag la de gang las/ /sdug bsngal mi skye ⑤rgyu nyid ni/ /thar yin rtag la de gang las/ ༈ /mi rtag nyid du brjod med gang / /de ni 'ga' yi'ang rjorgyu ma yin/ ༈ /brjod bya min la'ang bcings dang thar/ /ji lta bur yang yod ma yin/ /gang gi rang bzhin 'jig med pa/ /de la mkhas rnams rtag ces brjod/ /des na ngo tsha'i lta ba 'di/ /sgongs la de ni rtag par smros/ ༈ /bshad zin lam de goms pa las/ /gnas gyur gal te gnas gyur kyang / /lam bzhin skyon ni 'byung zhe na/ /ma yin nus pa med phyir ro/ ༈/rnam shes yul 'dzin pa yi chos/ /ji ltar yod de 'dzin pa dang / /yod 97—518

pa yi ni bdag nyid de/ /'di yis ①skyed par byed pa'ang yin/ /rang bzhin 'di yin 'di las de/ /rkyen gzhan gyis ni gol 'gyur zhing / ༈ /ldog pa la ni rkyen la ltos/ /mi brtan sbrul gyi blo bzhin no/ /sems kyi ④rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ /dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba/ /de phyir sngar yang nus med rnams/ /de bdag ④gyur la phyis nus med/ ༈ /nus yod na yang gnod pa can/ /skyed rjonus snying po can dngos la/ /yun du gnas nus yod min te/ /sa rlon la ni me bzhin no/ /'tshe ba med dang yang dag don/ /rang bzhin la ni phyin log gis—/ /'bad du zin kyang mi zlogs ⑤te/ /blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /bdag 'dzin rgyu gcig can nyid dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po'i phyir/ /'dod chags khong khro phan tshun du/ /tha dad na yang gnod ma yin/ /byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir/ /shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min/ ༈ /nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can/ /de yang 'jig tshogs lta ba yin/ /rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs phyir dang / /sems byung nyid kyis dmigs pa'i phyir/ /log par dmigs nyid ma rig par/ /gsungs duphyir gzhan ni rigs ma yin/ /'gal ba gang yin 'dir bshad bya/ /stong nyid lta dang de 'gal phyir/ /de yi rang bzhin nyes kun dang / /'gal bar rab tu grub pa yin/ ༈ /zad ⑦min srog chags chos nyid phyir/ /gzugs sogs bzhin min ma grub phyir/ /gnyen po'i phyogs dang 'byel ba na/ /ldog pa dag kyang mthong phyir ro/ ༈ /nyes pa rnam par 'gags pa ni⑧/ /sra zhing ⑨slar yang skye med de/ /de bdag nyid kyis 'bral med dang / /thal ba bzhin du ma nges phyir/ ༈ /gang zhig bdag mthong de la ni/ /nga zhes rtag tu zhen par 'gyur/ /zhen pas bde la 97—519

sred 'gyur te/ /sred pas skyon rnams sgrib par byed/ /yon tan mthong bas yongs sred ①pa/ /nga yi zhes de'i sgrub byed len/ /des na bdag la mngon chags pa/ /de srid de ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ ༈ /bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes—/ /bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang ④/ /'di dag dang ni yongs 'brel las/ /nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ ༈ /nges par bdag la chags pa ni/ /bdag gi la chags mi 'bral zhing / ༈ /nyes med bdag la chags pa dang / /bral ba'i rgyu yang yod ma yin/ ༈ /gal te chags pa skyon bcas na/ /de las cir 'gyur de spong 'gyur/ /'di yul sun phyung med par nirka/ /de spong bar ni ①nus ma yin/ ༈ /yon tan skyon dang rjes 'brel ba'i/ /'dod dang sdang sogs spong ba ni/ /de dag yul la ma mthong bas/ /yin gyi ④phyi tshul gang gis min/ ༈ /chags yon tan gyis chags min gyi⑤/ /don gyi yon tan mthong bas yin/ /ma tshang med rgyu de la ni/ /'bras bu gang gis zlog par byed/ ༈ /chags la skyon yang gang zhig mthong / ༈ /gal te sdug bsngal rten zhe na/ /de lta'ang 'di la chags bral min/ /bdag gir mthong phyir dper bdag bzhin/ ༈ /gal te de med bdag sdug bsngal/ /rgyu min de yang de dang 'dra/ ༈ /de ltar gnyis ka'ang skyon med pa/ /de phyir gnyis la chags bral minarjo/ ༈ /gal te sbrul bzung yan lag bzhin/ /sdug bsngal bsgoms pas spong 'gyur na/ /bdag gi ba blo bcom pas 'di/ /'dor ba yin gyi bzlog la ⑦min/ ༈ /dbang po la sogs longs spyod kyi/ /rten nyid du ni bzung ba la/ /rang blo gang gis bzlog 'gyur te⑧/ /de la chags bral de gang las/ ༈ /lus las bog pa'i skra sogs la/ /yid byung blo ni skye 'gyur 97—520

zhing / /gzhan la zhen bcas skye 'gyur ba/ /thams cad kyi ni mngon sum yin/ ༈/de la 'du sogs 'byel pa las/ /rang gi blo ni skye 'gyur ba'i/ /'brel te ①de bzhin nyid gnas phyir/ /mthong du zin kyang spong mi 'gyur/ ༈ /'du ba la sogs med na yang / /phan 'dogs nyid ni kun la yod/ ༈ /sdug bsngal bskyed phyir sor mo bzhin/ /rang gi blo ni mi 'gyur na/ /gcig tu de ni sdug bsngal min/ ༈ /phal cher dug bcas zas bzhin no/ /khyad par can bde ②la chags pas/ /de 'gal ba la chags bral 'gyur/ ༈ /khyad par can bde ①la sred pas/ /bde ba cung zad yongs su spong / ༈ /bsam med bdag la chags pa yis/ /ji ltar rnyed bzhin la 'jug ste/ /bud med dag ni ma rnyed par/ /dud 'gro la 'dod spyod mthong bzhin/ ༈ /bdag ni 'dod pa gang yin terjo/ /ji ltar de ni 'jig par 'dod/ ༈ /myong ba dang ni tha snyad dang / /yon tan kun gyi rten log pa/ /ji ltar zhen pa yin 'dod de/ /zhen pa'i rang bzhin de 'dra min/ ༈ /rnam pa kun tu bdag 'dzin ni/ /bdag la chags pa bstan ⑤par byed/ /de ni bdag gir zhen pa yi/ /sa bon gnas skabs de nyid rjoganas/ ༈ /brtson yang yon tan cha brten nas/ /'jug ldan bdag gi ba la ni/ /chags bral gegs byed pa nyid dang / /de yi skyon yang sgrib pa yin/ ༈ /gal te bdag la'ang chags bral na/ /da ni chags bral gang yin med/ /de ni ji ltar bdag 'dod padze+e/ /sdug bsngal bsgom ⑧pa don med 'gyur/ ༈ /de dag sdug bsngal bsgoms pas kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid ni rnam shes byed/ /de ni sngar yang mngon sum nyid/ /de lta na yang chags bral med/ /gal te de la nyes pa yis/ /skad cig de yi blo ldog kyang / /97—521

de la chags bral mi 'gyur te/ /'dod ldan bud med gzhan la bzhin/ ༈ /blang dang dor bya'i khyad yod na/ /gcig las byung ①ba'i chags gang yin/ /de nyid rnam grangs kyis bskyed tshe②/ /chags pa kun gyi sa bon yin/ /skyon med yul can chags pa dang / /sgrub byed kyang ni skyon med yin/ /'gro ba'ang de tsam nyid yin na/ /da ni gang la chags bral 'gyur/ /der de skyon bcas kyang yin na/ /de ni bdag la'ang mtshungs pa yin/ /der de'i skyon la chags bral med/ /da ni gang la de chags bral/ ༈ /yon tan mthong ba las byung ba'i/ /zhen pa nyes pa ①mthong bas 'jig ༈ /de ltar dbang sogs la de min/ /byis sogs la yang mthong phyir dang / /skyon ldan la yang yod phyir dang / /yon tan ldan yang gzhan dag la/ /med phyir 'das pa la sogs pa/ /bdag gi ba la med phyir ro/ ༈ /de nyid phyir na bdag gi ba'i/ /blo rgyu'ang yon tan mthong bas minadhi/ /de phyir yon tan min mthong bas/ /de yang spong ba ma yin no/ ༈ /gzhan yang yod min yon tan ni/ /sgo 'dogs chags pas der yang mthong / ༈ /des na de rgyu gnod med can/ /bsgrubs pas de la ji ltar gnod/ ༈ /mchog gzhan don du gnyer phyir dang / /skye 'jig blo can nyid kyi phyir/ /skye bo 'di yis dbang sogs las/ /bdag ni tha dad gyur par shes/ myu/ /de phyir gcig nyid mthong bas kyang / /chags min bdag la chags pa de/ /dmigs pa'i nang gi yan lag la/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rjes chags 'gyur/ ༈ /gang zhig da ltar sdug bsngal bas/ /yid 'byung de 'dra sdang yin gyi/ /chags bral ma yin de tshe yang / /chags yod skabs gzhan tshol phyir ro/ ༈ /zhe sdang sdug bsngal rgyu can phyir/ /de ni de srid tsam du 97—522

gnas—/ /de log na ni rang nyid kyi①/ /rang bzhin nyid la slar brten 'gyur/ ༈/blang dang dor bya spangs pa'i phyir/ /thams cad la ni mnyam snyoms can/ /tsan+dan ste'u mtshungs pa la/ /chags bral zhes ni brjod pa yin/ ༈ /'du byed sdug bsngal la dgongs nas/ /sdug bsngal bsgom ②par gsungs pa yin/ ༈ /nged kyi de yang rkyen las skyes/ /de ni bdag med lta brten yin/ /stong nyid lta bas grol bar 'gyur/ /sgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ ༈ /de phyir mi rtag las sdug bsngal/ /sdug bsngal las ni bdag med gsungs/ /chags bral min dang sred ldan dang / /rtsom pa kun la brten pa de/ ༈ /nyon mongs las las grol ma yin/ /de 'dra 'khor ba pa zhes bya/ ༈ /bdag gi nyid ni mi 'dod na/ /de yi za ba po yang med/ /bya dang longs spyod mtshan nyid can/ /de tshe ①de yi bdag kyang med/ ༈ /de phyir grol 'dod jog med pa'i/ /rgyu can rigs mthun sa bon las/ /byung ba'i 'jig tshogs lta ba dag /rtsa ba nyid nas dbyung bar gyis/ ༈ /lung ni de lta'i rjodangos yin pa'i/ /rgyu ma mthong ba rnams la ni/ /lung tsam gyis ni grol bar yang / /smra ba yongs su mgu byed min—/ ༈ /sa bon sogs grub cho ga ni/ /skyes bu mi skyed ⑤par nus min/ /til mar bskus dang mes rjobasregs sogs/ /bdag ⑦kyang grol bar thal phyir ro—/ ༈ /sngar phyi ba dag phyis yang phyir/ /sdig pa bcom par byas pa min/ /'di yi phyi nyid med 'gyur gyi/ /lus can min phyir sdig phyi min/ ༈ /log shes dang ni de las byung / /sred pa sems pa'i dbang dag gis/ /dman gnas 'gro ba skye ba yin/ /de phyir de bcad 'gro mi 'gyur/ /de tsam las ni 'byung ⑧ba'i phyir/ /skye la de dag nyid nus yin/ ༈ /sems pa de dag rang 97—523

nyid las/ /yin phyir skye rgyu nyams pa med/ /'gro dang rtogs rten byed pa yin//de ni ma mthong ba las 'gyur/ /ma mthong zhig phyir 'gro ba med/ /des na 'du byed sems pa min/ lnga/ /yod dang med pa'i rjes 'jug phyir/ /byed pa skyed 1la blo yi ni/ /nus mthong gzhan gyis snyem yin na/ /de yod de dag cis mi 'gro/ lho/ /gal te de dag nus med na/ /dbang sogs byas ma thag de dag /sems pa'i dbang gis 'dzin dang 'jug /g.yeng dang 'gog pa med par 'gyur/ lnga/ /ci ste de tshe blo med phyir/ /mi 'gyur dri ma rnams kyi kyiblo/ /mtshams sbyor de rnams nus med na/ /gson pa nyid na'ang nus med 'gyur/ pya//gnyen po dang ni rang gi phyogs/ /'phel na 5'grib dang 'phel ba'i phyir/ /nyes rgyun rang gi sa bon can/ /dbang bskur ba las sdog pa med/ /rtag pa rngultos pa med pa'i phyir/ /rim gyis skyed par byed pa dang / myu/ /byed dang mi byed pa dag ni/ /'dra ba'i bdag nyid byed pa thu'agal/ ༈ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'ang gcig par 'gyur/ /de dag de las tha dad na/ /byed po za po nyams par 'gyur/ stsa/ /nus pa yang ni 'grub ma yin/ myu/ /gzhan gyis dran dang longs spyod sogs/ /thal ba gnod byed ma yin te/ /'ga'i yang dran pa med pa'i phyir/ /des na myong las dran pa 'byung / ༈ /bden pa bzhi la brten kyepa dang / /bde dang nga dang nga'i zhes sogs/ /yang dag min pa rnam bcu drug /sgo btags nas ni yongs su sred/ myu/ /de nyid las rnguni de 'gal don/ /de nyid rnam pa rjes rtogs can/ /legs bsgoms yang dag lta ba yis/ /sred pa rjes 'brang kyebacas 'joms byed/ myu/ /las dang lus dag gnas na yang / /gcig med phyir na rgyu gsum can/ / skye ba 6srid pa ma yin te/ /sa bon med 97—524

par myu gu bzhin/ myu/ /las dang lus dag spong min te/ /gnyen po dag ni med phyir dang / /nus med phyir ro sred pa ni/ /yod na slar yang 'byung phyir ro—/ ༈ /gnyis zad don du 'bad na yang / /las zad dub pa don med yin/ /'bras bu sna tshogs mthong ba'i phyir/ /las rnams nus pa tha dad du/ /rjes dpog des na dka' thub kyi/ /nyon mongs dngos gcig gis mi mdzad/ myu/ /rnam 'gas de bskyed 'bras bu ni/ /chung 'gyur rigs mi mthun can min/ myu/ / 'bras bu nyams su myong ba ni/ /1ci ste dka' thub nus pa yis/ /nus pa 'dres pa zad pa na/ /nyon mongs cha 'ga' spong ba'am/ /nyon mongs med par kun spang ༄ sna'agyur/ /gal te dka' thub nyon mongs las/ /gzhan 'dod nyon mongs nyid ce na/ /de ni las 'bras yin phyir 'dis/ /nus pa 'dres sogs 'gyur ma yin/ ༈ /skye 'dod nyes pa bcom pa'i phyir/ /gang yang skyon rnams 'gog byed pa/ / des skyed ñchalas la nus 'gyur gyi/ /ji ltar byas pa nyams par 'gyur/ ༈ /las las nyes pa ma yin te/ /skyon ldan byed ④'gyur bzlog las min/ ༈ /log pa'i rnam rtog med par ni/ /bde ba las kyang 'dod mi 'gyur/ ༈ /skyob las de nyid dang brtan dang / /ma lus khyad par mkhyen par grub/ /gshegs pa rtogs pa'i don phyir te/ /de phyir phyi rol pa dang slob/ /mi slob las lhag de yi phyir/ /gzhan don mkhyen spyor de ston pa/ myu//de las brtse yin gzhan don ngor/ /don grub khyamadzad pa mi 'dor phyir/ lnga/ /brtse bas legs dang ye shes las/ /bden pa gsung mdzad sgrub byed bcas/ /de gsung bar ⑥yang mngon sbyor ldan/ /gang phyir des na tshad ma nyid/ myu/ /de lta'i dngos don bstod pa ni/ /de yi bstan pa nyid las ni/ /tshad ma'i de 97—525

nyid grub don derngu/ /rjes su dpag khupa ma bzlog phyir/ myu/ /cung zad skye ba'i bdag nyid can/ /gang de thams cad 'gag lkuchos can/ /zhes sogs rnam pa du mar ni/ /'di yi sbyor ba'ang 4mthong phyir ro/ /med na mi 'byung mtshan nyid can/ /rtags ni rjes dpag rten yin no/ /bsgrub byas gtan tshigs khyab pa ni/ /bstan phyir de yang gsal bar bshad/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi tshig le'ur byas pa cholas tshad ma grub pa zhes bya ba le'u gnyis pa'o// //gzhal bya gnyis phyir tshad ma gnyis/ /don byed nus dang mi nus phyir/ /skra shad la sogs don min te/ /don du mos pa med phyir ro/ /'dra dang mi 'dra nyid phyir dang / /sgra yi yul dang yul min phyir/ /rgyu mtshan gzhan ni yod pa na/ /blo ni yod dang med phyir ro/ lnga/ /don dam don byed nus pa gang / /de 'dir don dam yod pa yin/ /gzhan ni kun rdzob yod pa ste/ /de dag rang spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad/ lnga/ /gal te thams cad nus med na/ /sa bon sogs ni myug sogs la/ /nus mthong gal te de kun rdzob/ /'dod na ci ste de ltar 'gyur/ lnga/ /gal te kun la de yod na/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid rjes 'gro ldog /blo la ma mthong phyir min te/ /mig dang gzugs sogs blo bzhin no/ myu//des ni brda dang rtsol ba sogs/ /nang gi yan lag rjes 'jug phyir/ /bum pa 'degs hūṃdang spyi dang ni/ /grangs sogs blo ni bshad pa yin/ myu/ /skra shad sogs ni spyi min te/ /don du zhen pa med phyir ro/ myu/ /shes byar 'dzin phyir med pa la/ /nyes pa dag tu thal mi 'gyur/ ༈ /de dag gi yang de lta'i dngos / /bkag med gsal bar —snang ba nyid/ /shes pa'i ngo bo'i don 97—526

nyid phyir/ ༈ /skra sogs zhes bya'i blo dag ni/ /spyi yi spyod yul can yin la/ /skrar snang don med can yin no/ myu/ /gal te spyi ni shes ngo bo'i/ /don nyid yin na thal bar 'gyur/ /de ltar 'dod phyir skyon yod min/ lnga/ /don gyi ngo bo nyid kyi spyi/ /kun la ngo bo mtshungs phyir dang / /de ldog hūṃpa la brten phyir ro / ༈ /brjod bya nyid phyir de dngos min/ myu/ /dbang sogs 'bras bcas nyid phyir ro/ myu/ /ming sogs brjod na 'chad po dang / /nyan po brjod bya rjes 'byel can/ /ming sogs 'byel pa med pa can/ /don la 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te don la tshul 'dra las/ /'khrul 'jug gyur 2na dus kun dang / /yul la 'khrul min shes pa la/ /mtshungs min rnam pa de 'dra'i blo/ /skye spyophyir gzhan la de med de/ /phyi rol don du snang ba yi/ /blo ni khas len med phyir ro/ myu/ /khas len na yang rnam shes las/ /tha dad pa na 4tshad can min / /jog pa grub pa med phyir ro/ stsa/ /shes kun don ldan phyir zhe na/ /'thad min rmi sogs rnam gzhan du/ /mthong phyir 'du byed las kyang min/ /sngo la sogs par snang phyir ro/ myu/ / thogs med phyir na 5sngo sogs min/ lnga/ /rung ⑥ yul gnas pas mi shes pa/ /rang nyid shes phyir de shes yin/ /des ni ming sogs brjod pa yinagye/ myu/ /mig la sogs pa'i blo 'dod pa/ /de nyid don ldan gang gis 'dod/ /gal te don nus mthong phyir na/ /gzhan pa don med can thob 'gyur/ ༈ /'byel med na yang 'jug mi 'gyur/ /gal te don dang 'byel ldan na/ /'das dang ma 'ongs brjod bya min/ /don 8dang de ni zad phyir ro/ myu/ /sgra swos thuspyi ni brjod pa'i phyir/ lnga/ /gal te thal bar mi 'dod na/ /de min spyi ni yan gar ba/ /brjod med phyir ro 7brjod na yang //97—527

de mtshungs min dang gsal ba min/ /des na rtag tu dmigs 'gyur te/ /rtag nyid phyir ro gal te yang / /gsal las mngon sum la gsal yin/ /bdag la shes pa skyed pa na①/ /nus pa gang de nus nyid yin/ /gal te 'ga' tshe nus med na/ /de ni kun tshe ②nus med 'gyur/ ༈ /de yis ⑦nus pa'am nus med pa/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gang gnas pa/ /rtag phyir bcos su yod min na/ /de zad bya phyir nus pa gang / ༈ /spyi yi rnam par shes de dang / /rjes 'byel sngon po la sogs pa'i/ /rnam pa'i cha ni rnam nges gang / /de ni de la gang gis sprul/ /gal te mngon sum shes don nyid/ /phyir na dbang po don med min/ /de dngos gcig phyir sgra sogs las/ /tha dad snang blo gang las yin/ ༈ /rigs ldan rigs min gang gi phyir/ /gsal ba'i ngo bo gzhan rten med/ /gal te tha dad grub ce na/ /ltos phyir 'bras bu nyid du brjod/ /rang gi rgyu las grub pa'i phyir/ /'bras bu rag las med par yang / /rtog pa yis duni 'brel par byed/ /'bras min ji ltar yang ci zhig /gzhan nyid yin na de 'byel ⑤med/ /de phyir rang bzhin med par grub/ ༈ /med pa'i rjorigs su thal mi 'gyur/ /de la ltos pa med pa'i phyir/ ༈ /de phyir ngo bo la brten nas/ /ngo bo med pa'i rigs brtags pa/ /khyad par de la 'jug don can—/ /sgra rnams kyis ni rab tu bstan/ /de la ngo bor ⑦snang ba 'am/ /don la de nyid du 'dzin pa/ /gang de 'khrul pa thog med pa'i/ /dus can mthong goms kyis sprul yin/ ༈ /don rnams kyi ni spyi gang yin/ /gzhan las log ⑧pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /sgra 'di dag gis gang brjod pa/ /de la ngo bo cung zad med/ ༈ /ngo bo med can spyi blo la/ /spyi nyid du ni mthong phyir dang / /97—528

don la 'khrul pa'am ①med pa ni/ /spyir khru'adod de yang bslad phyir dang / /de nyid du na ①don dngos su/ /med phyir ngo bo can ma yin/ /ngo bo med pas brjod bya min/ /gal te brjod bya 'ga' zhig las/ /dngos 'dod dngos rnams ji ltar yang / /brjod bya min pa nyid ma yin/ /nyer len tha dad phyir gzhan du/ /brjod par bya min nyer brtags rjophyir/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs pa'i/ /don la'ang ⑤spyi yi rgyu can gyi/ /mnyan pa dag ni 'jug 'gyur na—/ /yod pa med chos ji ltar 'gyur/ ༈ /gal te nyer brtags las de 'dod—/ /gang zhig snam sogs la med la/ /da rjoltar ba yi bum pa yi/ /dngos med dang ni nye ba gang / ༈ /blo ni 'khrul pa med 'jug pa/ /rtag tu dngos dang sgo 'dogs la/ /seng ge bram ze'i ge la/ /de ltar brjod pa'ang 'jig rten yod/ ༈ /don med na yang 'gro ba yis/ /gang la grags pas sgra bkod pa/ /de la de dngos ⑦de mtshungs phyir/ /'khrul rtog ⑧can gzhan phal pa yin/ ༈ /ji ltar dngos po nus med la/ /med ce'am rtog pa ji bzhin du/ /nus la'ang gtso bo la sogs pa'i/ /mnyan pa skye bos byas pa yin/ ༈/zhig la ⑨sgra las blo ji 'dra/ /snang ba de 'dra ma zhig la'ang / ༈ /rna ba la sogs rnam par shes/ /don yod can la de dag med/ ༈ /spyi tsam 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir/ /sems gnyis dag ni mtshungs pa yin/ /de 'ba' zhig ni 'dzin byed pa/ /sngar ni rnam par bzlog ⑩zin to/ ༈ /phan tshun khyad par can rnams ni/ /khyad med ngo bo ji ltar 'gyur/ /ngo bo nyid gnyis yod na yang / /de dngos gcig tu ji ltar 'gyur/ /gal te de dag mtshungs pa yi/ /dngos de de dag las gzhan nyid/ /de dag gi zhes 'byel med 'gyur/ /ldog 97—529

pa la ni sun dbyung med/ /de phyir mtshungs nyid spyi 'di la/ /dngos po med pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /de 'bras she na du ma dang / /'jig 'gyur de yang 'dod ma yin/ /'jig pa dngos po tsam dang ni/ /rjes 'brel phyir na rtag nyid min/ /rigs rnams 'bras bu min phyir na/ /ma 'byel pa dang dngos med 'gyur/ ༈ /dngos po'i stobs kyis ①skyes pa yin④/ /shes pa gang de brda dag la/ /ltos pa ma yin spyi yi ni/ /blo la de ltar snang ba med/ ༈ /dngos gnyis mthong la blo 'ga' zhig /brda med na yang tha dad med/ /rjes su 'jug pa gang yin de①/ /don nye ba dang 'brel ba yin/ /ji ltar rigs med shes pa yi/ /'bras can mig sogs nye 'dod bzhin/ ༈ /gang gis rnam par phye ba yis/ /rigs kyang rjes su 'gro ba yin/ ༈ /rnam pa 'gas kyang rnam shes la/ /de dngos snang ba med phyir ro/ /gzugs can yin phyir dbang rnams la/ /gal te lta ba po yod na/ /de lus snang 'gyur rigs rnams ni/ /ma yin yan gar mthong min phyir/ /gsal 'dzin tshe na'ang dude sgra dang / /ngo bo las gzhan snang ba med/ ༈ /de phyir de ni shes tsam gyi/ /don byed par yang mi rung ngo / ༈ /de mi rung phyir rang bzhin med/ /de ni dngos med mtshan nyid yin/ ༈ /ji skad bshad las bzlog gang yin/ /de ni rang gi mtshan nyid 'dod/ ༈ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka la/ /brten ⑤phyir spyi de'ang rnam pa gsum/ ༈ /gal te dngos brten dngos 'byel phyir/ /dngos po shes 'gyur zhe na min/ /lan btab phyir dang 'das sogs la/ /rnam pa gzhan du mthong phyir ro/ ༈ /gal te dngos chos nyid nyams na/ /dngos por 'dzin pa sngon 'gro can/ /de shes yin phyir nyes 'di med/ ༈ /rang gi mtshan 97—530

nyid gcig gzhal ①bya/ /yod med nyid du dpyod rnams kyi/ /don bya de las grub phyir ro/ /de ni rang gzhan ngo bo yis/ /rtogs phyir gzhal bya gnyis su bzhed—/ /ji bzhin mngon zhen min pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa ②'khrul pa yin par bzhed—/ /gal te gzhan gyi ngo bos ni/ /rtogs ①na 'khrul pa tshad ma minarjo/ ༈/bsam pa la ni bslu ⑤med phyir/ /'khrul pa yin yang tshad ma nyid/ /rnam gzhan gyis kyang rtogs pa mthong / /phyogs 'di la ni lan btab zin/ ༈ /nor bu sgron me'i rjo'od dag la/ /nor bu'i blo yis mngon rgyug pa/ /log pa'i shes par khyad med kyang / /ji ltar don byed la khyad yod/ ༈/de ltar ji bzhin don med na'ang / /rjes dpag dang ni der snang dag /don byed pa dang rjes 'brel bas/ /tshad ma nyid du rnam par gzhag⑦ ༈ /gang la don gyi nus pa lasaske/ /rjes 'gro ldog pa can gyi blo/ /de la 'dzin pa rang dbang can/ ༈/de las gzhan dngos dbang po 'das/ /ma khrumathong bdag nyid ngo bo de/ /rtog ⑨pa'i rten ni don gzhan yin/ /gal te de rten dang 'brel can/ /yin na de tshe go byed nyid/ ༈ /de tshe go byed rjes 'gro ba/ ༈ /spyi yi ngo bo nyid du rtogasaske/ /des na sgog gyur don thams cad/ /khyad par du ni rtogs mi 'gyur—/ /'brel pa can gyi chos las ni/ /chos can la rtogs ⑩skye ba gang / /de ni rjes dpag sgog gyur gyi/ /sgrub byed gcig tu nges pa yin/ ༈ /mngon sum lkog ⑪tu gyur pa las/ /gzhal bya gzhan ni yod ma yin/ ༈ /de phyir gzhal bya gnyis nyid kyis⑫/ /tshad ma gnyis su bzhed pa dang / /gzhal bya gnyis ni mthong ba'i phyir/ /gsum gcig grangs ni gsal ⑫ba yin/ ༈ /med pa gzhal bya ma yin phyir/ /gcig nyid ce na kho bo'ang 'dod/ ༈ /med pa'ang 97—531
